BURHAN:v1p450/r1.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v1p450/r1.speaker: author
BURHAN:v1p450/r1.claim: At a verse addressing believers, the reciter should pause, reflect on its commands and prohibitions, accept them, and repent of past failures.
BURHAN:v1p450/r1.anchor: وإن هو مر بآية فيها نداء للذين آمنوا فقال يأيها الذين آمنوا وقف عندها وقد كان بعضهم يقول لبيك ربى وسعديك

BURHAN:v1p450/r2.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v1p450/r2.speaker: author
BURHAN:v1p450/r2.claim: People must monitor their family's prayer, fasting, purification, major ritual impurity, menstruation, and postpartum obligations, asking to remind or teach them.
BURHAN:v1p450/r2.anchor: وعلى كل أحد أن ينظر فى أمر أهله فى صلاتهم وصيامهم وأداء ما يلزمهم فى طهاراتهم وجناياتهم وحيض النساء ونفاسهن

BURHAN:v1p450/r3.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v1p450/r3.speaker: author
BURHAN:v1p450/r3.claim: Parents should teach young children these practices at seven or eight and discipline them for neglect at ten; anyone who previously fell short should resolve to comply in future.
BURHAN:v1p450/r3.anchor: ثم هكذا يراعى صغار ولده ويعلمهم إذا بلغوا سبعا أو ثمانى سنين ويضربهم إذا بلغوا العشر على ترك ذلك

DAMGHANI:v1p468/r5.author: al-Dāmghānī
DAMGHANI:v1p468/r5.speaker: author
DAMGHANI:v1p468/r5.claim: Nār can refer to Hell, as in the fire fueled by people and stones and its parallel in Āl ʿImrān.
DAMGHANI:v1p468/r5.anchor: الثالث النار هي جهنم قوله تعالى في سورة التحريم نارا وقودها الناس والحجارة نظيرها في سورة آل عمران ونحوه

TABATABAI:21:16-33#4/r4.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:21:16-33#4/r4.speaker: الرضا
TABATABAI:21:16-33#4/r4.claim: In a report about Harut and Marut, al-Rida says angels are protected by God's grace from disbelief and disgraceful acts, citing verses that describe their obedience and uninterrupted worship.
TABATABAI:21:16-33#4/r4.anchor: إن الملائكة معصومون محفوظون عن الكفر والقبائح بألطاف الله تعالى

RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r1.claim: Protect yourselves by refraining from what God has forbidden.
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r1.anchor: بالانتهاء عما نهاكم الله تعالى عنه

RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r2.speaker: مقاتل
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r2.claim: Muqātil says this means disciplining oneself and one’s family, enjoining good and forbidding evil.
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r2.anchor: مقاتل : أن يؤدب المسلم نفسه وأهله

RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r3.speaker: الكشاف
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r3.claim: The Kashshāf says to protect oneself by leaving sins and performing duties, and to protect one’s family by holding them accountable as oneself is held accountable.
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r3.anchor: في ( الكشاف ) : { قوا أنفسكم } بترك المعاصي وفعل الطاعات

RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r4.speaker: قيل
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r4.claim: Another view says to guard oneself against the soul’s promptings, since the soul commands evil.
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r4.anchor: وقيل : { قوا أنفسكم } مما تدعو إليه أنفسكم

RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r5.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r5.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r5.claim: A reading has nominative أهلوكم, coordinated with the wāw in ءامنوا قوا; the intervening words make the coordination acceptable.

RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r6.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r6.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r6.claim: The fire is a kind whose fuel consists only of people and stones.
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r6.anchor: نوعا من النار لا يتقد إلا بالناس والحجارة

RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r7.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r7.speaker: ابن عباس
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r7.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās identifies the stones as sulfur, because it is among the hottest things when kindled.
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r7.anchor: وعن ابن عباس هي حجارة الكبريت

RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r8.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r8.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r8.claim: A variant reading has َوَقُودُهَا with ḍamma on the wāw.

RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r9.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r9.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r9.claim: The angels over the Fire are the nineteen keepers and their assistants.

RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r10.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r10.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r10.claim: Harshness and severity may describe their bodies, meaning coarseness and strength, or their actions, meaning roughness and force; either could characterize their nature or conduct.
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r10.anchor: في أجرامهم غلظة وشدة أي جفاء وقوة

RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r11.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r11.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r11.claim: They may be severe toward God’s enemies and merciful toward His allies, as another verse says.
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r11.anchor: أشداء على أعداء الله ، رحماء على أولياء الله

RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r12.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r12.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r12.claim: Their execution of commands explains their severity: pity does not stop them carrying out God’s orders or punishing His enemies.
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r12.anchor: لا تأخذهم رأفة في تنفيذ أوامر الله تعالى والانتقام من أعدائه

RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r13.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r13.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r13.claim: The verse indicates that angels are morally tasked in the afterlife with what God commands and forbids, and that disobedience means violating command or prohibition.
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#2/r13.anchor: وفيه إشارة إلى أن الملائكة مكلفون في الآخرة بما أمرهم الله تعالى به وبما ينهاهم عنه

RAZI-FULL:v30p41#3/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#3/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#3/r1.claim: Believers are told to avoid sinful conduct that would place them alongside the disbelievers for whom the Fire was prepared; the command may also warn them against apostasy.
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#3/r1.anchor: باجتناب الفسق مجاورة الذين أعدت لهم هذه النار

RAZI-FULL:v30p41#3/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#3/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#3/r2.claim: Even if sinful believers occupy a higher level than disbelievers, they share the same abode, which grounds the warning to protect oneself; avoiding apostasy may also be intended.
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#3/r2.anchor: فإنهم مع الكفار في دار واحدة

RAZI-FULL:v30p41#3/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#3/r3.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#3/r3.claim: Since angels are spirits, Rāzī finds it more plausible that harshness and severity describe their qualities rather than their substance.
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#3/r3.anchor: وهذا أقرب بالنسبة إلى الغير من الأقوال

RAZI-FULL:v30p41#3/r4.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#3/r4.speaker: الكشاف
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#3/r4.claim: The Kashshāf distinguishes the clauses: angels accept and adhere to God’s commands without denying them, then carry out what they are commanded.
RAZI-FULL:v30p41#3/r4.anchor: معنى الأول أنهم يتقبلون أوامره ويلتزمونها ولا ينكرونها ، ومعنى الثاني أنهم ( يؤدون ) ما يؤمرون به كذا ذكره في ( الكشاف )

STUDYQURAN:66:intro/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:66:intro/r1.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:66:intro/r1.claim: Al-Taḥrīm likely dates to 7/629 and is Madinan; a minority considers only verses 1–9 Madinan and the last three Makkan.

STUDYQURAN:66:intro/r3.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:66:intro/r3.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:66:intro/r3.claim: The sūrah moves from the Prophet's relationship with his wives in verses 1–5 to believers' protection and repentance (6, 8), disbelievers' fate (7), and the Prophet's struggle against revelation's opponents (9).
STUDYQURAN:66:intro/r3.anchor: the subject of this sūrah is the relationship between the Prophet and his wives (vv. 1–5)

STUDYQURAN:66:6/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:66:6/r1.speaker: Ṭ
STUDYQURAN:66:6/r1.claim: Shielding oneself and one's family from the Fire means obedience and reverence to God, and enjoining them on one's family.
STUDYQURAN:66:6/r1.anchor: Shield yourselves and your families by being obedient and reverent and enjoining obedience and reverence to God (Ṭ)

STUDYQURAN:66:6/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:66:6/r2.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:66:6/r2.claim: This is the only verse that tells believers to shield themselves from the Fire; elsewhere they ask God to protect them, as in 3:16, 3:191, and 40:7.
STUDYQURAN:66:6/r2.anchor: This is the only verse in which believers are told to shield themselves from the Fire

STUDYQURAN:66:6/r3.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:66:6/r3.speaker: JJ
STUDYQURAN:66:6/r3.claim: Stones likely refer to idols worshipped by idolaters because they were made of stone, or to stones themselves.
STUDYQURAN:66:6/r3.anchor: stones likely refers to the idols worshipped by the idolaters, as they were made of stone (JJ) or were in fact stones

STUDYQURAN:66:6/r4.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:66:6/r4.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:66:6/r4.claim: The angels are guardians of Hell, whose number is given as nineteen in 74:30.
STUDYQURAN:66:6/r4.anchor: The angels referred to here are the guardians of Hell, of whom the Quran says there are nineteen (74:30).

TAB-FULL:v23p103/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p103/r1.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v23p103/r1.claim: Believers should teach one another what protects them from the Fire, perform God’s obedience, and thereby ward it off.
TAB-FULL:v23p103/r1.anchor: من تعلمونه النار، وتدفعونها عنه إذا عمل به من طاعة الله، واعملوا بطاعة الله.

TAB-FULL:v23p104/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p104/r1.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v23p104/r1.claim: Teach family members obedience to God so they can protect themselves from the Fire.
TAB-FULL:v23p104/r1.anchor: عن منصور، عن رجل، عن علي بن أبي طالب، رضي الله عنه في

TAB-FULL:v23p104/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p104/r2.speaker: علي بن أبي طالب
TAB-FULL:v23p104/r2.claim: ʿAlī explains the command as teaching and disciplining one’s family.
TAB-FULL:v23p104/r2.anchor: عن منصور، عن رجل، عن علي بن أبي طالب، رضي الله عنه في

TAB-FULL:v23p104/r3.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p104/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
TAB-FULL:v23p104/r3.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says to obey God, avoid disobedience, and enjoin one’s family to remember Him, by which God saves them from the Fire.
TAB-FULL:v23p104/r3.anchor: عن ابن عباس، قوله {قوا أنفسكم وأهليكم نارا} [التحريم: 6] يقول: اعملوا بطاعة الله، واتقوا معاصي الله

TAB-FULL:v23p104/r4.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p104/r4.speaker: مجاهد
TAB-FULL:v23p104/r4.claim: Mujāhid says to fear God and counsel one’s family to fear Him.
TAB-FULL:v23p104/r4.anchor: عن مجاهد، في قول الله: {قوا أنفسكم وأهليكم نارا} [التحريم: 6] قال: اتقوا الله، وأوصوا أهليكم بتقوى الله

TAB-FULL:v23p104/r5.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p104/r5.speaker: قتادة
TAB-FULL:v23p104/r5.claim: Qatāda says protect family by commanding obedience, forbidding sin, supervising and helping them follow God’s commands, and restraining them when they sin.
TAB-FULL:v23p104/r5.anchor: عن قتادة، {قوا أنفسكم وأهليكم نارا وقودها الناس والحجارة} [التحريم: 6] قال: قال: يقيهم أن يأمرهم بطاعة الله، وينهاهم عن معصيته

BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r2.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r2.claim: The imperative comes from الوقاية, to guard, protect, or preserve; نفس here means the human person, not the commanding lower self.
BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r2.anchor: أمر من الوقاية بمعنى الحفظ والحماية الصيانة له أو قيوا كاضربوا

BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r3.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r3.claim: The command means to keep oneself safe and distant from sin through obedience, advice, discipline, and teaching.
BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r3.anchor: يعني بترك المعاصي وفعل الطاعات بالنصح والتأديب والتعليم

BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r4.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r4.claim: أهليكم derives from أهلين with the n dropped in the construct; أهل may also take the irregular plural أالي and includes dependents supported by a man, including wife, children, relatives, and servant, or companions.
BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r4.anchor: أصله أهلين جمع أهل حذفت النون بالإضافة وقد يجمع على أالي على غير قياس وهو كل من في عيال الرجل والنفقته

BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r5.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r5.claim: The verse establishes an obligation to enjoin right, with relatives approached first.
BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r5.anchor: ودلت الآية على وجوب الأمر بالمعروف للأقرب فالأقرب

BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r6.speaker: الحديث
BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r6.claim: A hadith asks a man to remind his family about prayer, fasting, almsgiving, the poor, orphans, and neighbors, so that God may gather them together in Paradise.
BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r6.anchor: رحم الله رجلا قال يا أهلاء صلاتكم صيامكم زكاتكم مسكينكم يتيمكم جيرانكم لعل الله يجمعكم معهم في الجنة

BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r7.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r7.speaker: الحديث
BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r7.claim: The hadith that everyone is a shepherd makes each person accountable for the just care or faithful stewardship entrusted to them, including rulers, spouses, and servants.
BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r7.anchor: وهو من الرعاية بمعنى الحفظ يعني كلكم ملتزم بحفظ ما يطالب به من العدل إن كان وليا ومن عدم الخيانة

BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r8.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r8.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r8.claim: A report says the most severely punished on Judgment Day is one who neglected to teach or guide their family.
BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r8.anchor: وقيل أشد الناس عذابا يوم القيامة من جهل أهله

BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r9.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r9.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r9.claim: Relatives are singled out though strangers have the same general duty because kin are the first priority, and conditions for enjoining right may be absent with strangers; a man is ruler over his family.
BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r9.anchor: وخص الأهلين بالنصيحة مع أن حكم الأجانب كحكمهم في ذلك لأن الأقارب أولى بالنصيحة لقربهم

BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r10.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r10.speaker: بعض أهل الإشارة
BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r10.claim: Some people of spiritual allusion say purify yourselves from love of worldly life so your households become righteous by following you; a leader’s lapse becomes the followers’ lapse.
BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r10.anchor: طهروا أنفسكم عن دنس محبة الدنيا حتى تكون أهاليكم صالحين بمتابعتكم

BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r11.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r11.speaker: القاشاني
BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r11.claim: Al-Qashani defines true family through spiritual attachment and passionate love, physical or otherwise; whatever one loves necessarily accompanies one in this life and the next and must be guarded from the Fire like oneself.
BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r11.anchor: وقال القاشاني رحمه الله الأهل بالحقيقة هو الذي بينه وبين الرجل تعلق روحاني واتصال عشقي سواء اتصل به اتصالا جسمانيا أم لا

BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r12.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r12.speaker: القاشاني
BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r12.claim: Al-Qashani warns that if one’s self remains unpurified while loving an immersed soul, that attachment draws one into the abyss, whether the beloved is a natural faculty or another human sunk in material existence.
BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r12.anchor: فإن زكى نفسه عن الهيئات الظلمانية وفيه ميل ومبحة لبعض النفوس المنغمسة فيها لم يزكها بالحققة لأنه بتلك المحبة ينجذب إليها

BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r13.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r13.speaker: القاشاني
BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r13.claim: Al-Qashani urges the sincere to love the pure and saints so they are gathered with them, since a person is resurrected with those they love.
BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r13.anchor: ولهذا يجب على الصادق محبة الأصفياء والأولياء ليحشر معه فإن المرء يحشر مع من أحب

BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r14.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r14.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r14.claim: نارا means a kind or sort of fire, and وقودها means what fuels it, namely firewood.
BURSEVI:v10p43#2/r14.anchor: نوعا من النار {وقودها} ما يوقد به تلك النار يعني حطبها

BURSEVI:v10p44/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p44/r1.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p44/r1.claim: With fatḥa, وقود is the material burned, such as wood; with ḍamma it is the verbal noun meaning burning or ignition.
BURSEVI:v10p44/r1.anchor: فالوقود بالفتح اسم لما توقد به النار من الحطب وغيره والوقود بالضم مصدر بمعنى الاتقاد

BURSEVI:v10p44/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p44/r2.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p44/r2.claim: A variant reads وقودها with ḍamma, understood by supplying ‘cause of its fuel’ or as an intensive usage.
BURSEVI:v10p44/r2.anchor: وقرىء به بتقدير أسباب وقودها أو بالحمل على المبالغة

BURSEVI:v10p44/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p44/r3.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p44/r3.claim: الناس means unbelieving humans and jinn; jinn are not separately named because the warning addresses humans and jinn follow human unbelievers, whose denial came first.
BURSEVI:v10p44/r3.anchor: المقصود في الآية تحذير الأنس ولأن كفار الجن تابعة لكفار الإنس

BURSEVI:v10p44/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p44/r4.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p44/r4.claim: The stones burn as fuel, showing the Fire’s extreme heat and force because burning stones instead of wood indicates greater heat.
BURSEVI:v10p44/r4.anchor: أي تتقدبها أيضا اتقاد غيرها بالحطب فيه بيان لغاية إحراقها وشدة قوتها

BURSEVI:v10p44/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p44/r5.speaker: رسول الله
BURSEVI:v10p44/r5.claim: The Prophet is cited as saying that your fire is one part of seventy of the Fire of Hell.
BURSEVI:v10p44/r5.anchor: قال عليه السلام ، تاركم جزء من سبعين جزءا من نار جهنم وعن ابن عباس

BURSEVI:v10p44/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p44/r6.speaker: ابن عباس
BURSEVI:v10p44/r6.claim: Ibn Abbas identifies the stones as sulfur, describing it as intensely hot, quick to ignite, foul-smelling, smoky, and adhesive to bodies, making torment with it more severe.
BURSEVI:v10p44/r6.anchor: وعن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهم ، هي حجارة الكبريت وهي أشد الأشياء حرا إذا أوقد عليها ولها سرعة الاتقاد

BURSEVI:v10p44/r7.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p44/r7.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p44/r7.claim: People become fuel once they arrive in Hell, while the stones serve as fuel before they arrive.
BURSEVI:v10p44/r7.anchor: وقدوها الناس إذا صاروا إليها ولحجارة قبل أن يصيروا إليها

BURSEVI:v10p44/r8.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p44/r8.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p44/r8.claim: Bursevi cites al-Kashifi’s Persian verses about stones from which unbelievers fashioned idols and gold or silver, along with the Quranic warning about idols as fuel, to illustrate the worshippers’ misplaced trust.
BURSEVI:v10p44/r8.anchor: إنكم وما تعبدون من دون الله حصب جهنم

BURSEVI:v10p44/r9.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p44/r9.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p44/r9.claim: Another interpretation takes the stones as people so hardened against accepting truth that they are like stones or harder, as in the cited verse.
BURSEVI:v10p44/r9.anchor: أرد بالحجارة اذين هم في صلابتهم عن قبول الحق كالحجارة كمن وصفهم بقوله فهي كالحجارة أو أشد قسوة

BURSEVI:v10p44/r10.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p44/r10.speaker: التأويلات النجمية
BURSEVI:v10p44/r10.claim: Al-Tawilat al-Najmiyya reads the command as protecting believers of intellectual faith from the spiritual fire of distance and expulsion, fueled by selves that ignored the primordial covenant and by hardened hearts bearing animal, bestial, predatory, and satanic traits.
BURSEVI:v10p44/r10.anchor: في التأويلات النجمية : يا أيها الذينان آمنوا بالإيمان العلمي قوا أنفسكم وأهليكم من القوى الروحانية نار حجاب البعد والطرد

BURSEVI:v10p44/r11.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p44/r11.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p44/r11.claim: The believers are told to avoid the Fire prepared for unbelievers, as in al-Baqara, to intensify the warning; sinful believers share that abode below unbelievers, so the command concerns avoiding sin, not apostasy, which al-Tafsir al-Kabir calls unlikely.
BURSEVI:v10p44/r11.anchor: وأمر الله المؤمنين باتقاء هذه النار المعدة للكافرين كما نص عليه في سورة البقرة

BURSEVI:v10p44/r12.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p44/r12.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p44/r12.claim: The angels are the keepers and punishers of the Fire, the Zabaniyah, numbered among its nineteen guardians.
BURSEVI:v10p44/r12.anchor: تلى أمرها وتعذيب أهلها وهم الزبانية لتسعة عشر وأوانهم

BURSEVI:v10p44/r13.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p44/r13.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p44/r13.claim: على does not mean physically atop the Fire; it indicates authority, responsibility, mastery, and control over its affairs and inhabitants.
BURSEVI:v10p44/r13.anchor: فليس المراد بعلى الاستعلاء الحسي بل الولاية والقيام والاستيلاء والغلبة على ما فيها من الأمور

BURSEVI:v10p44/r14.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p44/r14.speaker: القاشاني
BURSEVI:v10p44/r14.claim: Al-Qashani interprets the angels as celestial and spiritual powers governing terrestrial affairs, including planetary and zodiacal spirits and other powers entrusted with bodily nature.
BURSEVI:v10p44/r14.anchor: قال القاشاني هي القوى السماوية والملكوتية الفعالة في الأمور الأرضية التي هي روحانيات الكواكب السبعة والبروج الأثنى عشر

BURSEVI:v10p44/r15.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p44/r15.speaker: القاشاني
BURSEVI:v10p44/r15.claim: Al-Qashani says human souls could ascend to the realm of dominion and influence those powers if freed from bodily ranks; immersed in bodily concerns and material forms, they instead become subject to and imprisoned by those powers.
BURSEVI:v10p44/r15.anchor: التي لو تجردت هذه النفوس الإنسانية عنها ترقت من مراتبها والصلت بعالم الجبروت وصارت مؤثرة في هذه القوى

BURSEVI:v10p45/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p45/r1.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p45/r1.claim: غلاظ means rough or harsh, with hearts empty of compassion and mercy.
BURSEVI:v10p45/r1.anchor: جمع غليظ بمعنى خشن خال قلبه عن الشفقة والرحمة

BURSEVI:v10p45/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p45/r2.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p45/r2.claim: شداد is the plural of شديد and means strong or powerful.
BURSEVI:v10p45/r2.anchor: بمعنى القوى لأنهم أقوياء لا يعجزون عن الانتقام

BURSEVI:v10p45/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p45/r3.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p45/r3.claim: Another gloss says they are harsh in speech and forceful in action, able to exact vengeance on God’s enemies and unmoved by pleas for mercy; their nature is wrath and severity.
BURSEVI:v10p45/r3.anchor: وقيل غلاظ الأقوال شداد الأفعال أقوياء على الأفعال الشديدة يعملون بأرجلهم كما يعملون بأيديهم

BURSEVI:v10p45/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p45/r4.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p45/r4.claim: A report describes one angel’s mouth as a year’s journey across and says a single blow with his mace sends seventy thousand people falling into Hell.
BURSEVI:v10p45/r4.anchor: ما بين منكى أحدهم مسيرة سنة أو كما بين الشمرق والمغرب يضرب أحدهم بمقمعته ضربة واحدة سبيعن ألفا

BURSEVI:v10p45/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p45/r5.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p45/r5.claim: ما may be a verbal noun, making the phrase a supplement explaining God’s command, or a relative pronoun after an omitted preposition, meaning the angels do not refuse the order and are resolved to carry it out.
BURSEVI:v10p45/r5.anchor: على أنه بدل اشتمال من الله وما مصدرية

BURSEVI:v10p45/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p45/r6.speaker: الكاشفي
BURSEVI:v10p45/r6.claim: Al-Kashifi says they cannot be bribed into disobeying an order, unlike the bribable agents of worldly kings.
BURSEVI:v10p45/r6.anchor: فليست هذه الجملة مع التي بعدها في معنى واحد (وقال الكاشفي) :

BURSEVI:v10p45#2/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p45#2/r1.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p45#2/r1.claim: They carry out their commands without sluggishness, delay, omission, or addition.
BURSEVI:v10p45#2/r1.anchor: أي يؤدون ما يؤمرون به من غير تثاقل وتوان وتأخير وزيادة نقصان

BURSEVI:v10p45#2/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p45#2/r2.speaker: القاضي
BURSEVI:v10p45#2/r2.claim: Al-Qadi reads the first clause as their past non-disobedience and the second as their continuing future performance of commands.
BURSEVI:v10p45#2/r2.anchor: وقال القاضي لا يعصون الله ما أمرهم فيما مضى ويستمرون على فعل ما يؤمرون به في المستقبل

BURSEVI:v10p45#2/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p45#2/r3.speaker: بعضهم
BURSEVI:v10p45#2/r3.claim: Some explain the shift from past to future by noting that disobedience or its absence follows a command, while punishment of the wretched recurs in the future.
BURSEVI:v10p45#2/r3.anchor: قال بعضهم لعل التعير في الأمر أو لا بالماضي مع نفي العصيان بالمستقبل

BURSEVI:v10p45#2/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p45#2/r4.speaker: بعض الكبار
BURSEVI:v10p45#2/r4.claim: Some great masters infer the infallibility of all heavenly angels: they are intellects without conflicting desire or appetite, unlike humans; the source distinguishes angels that never ascend from earth and angels that never descend from heaven.
BURSEVI:v10p45#2/r4.anchor: قال بعض الكبار في هذه الآية دليل على عصمة جميع الملائكة السماوية وذلك لأنهم عقول مجردة بلا منازع ولا شهوة

BURSEVI:v10p45#2/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p45#2/r5.speaker: بعض الكبار
BURSEVI:v10p45#2/r5.claim: The same discussion says these angels have no prohibitions to avoid and so miss the reward for refraining, unlike humans and earthly angels, who earn reward both by obeying commands and avoiding prohibitions.
BURSEVI:v10p45#2/r5.anchor: وفيها دليل أيضا على أنه لا نهي عند هؤلاء الملائكة فلا عبادة للنهي عندهم ففاتهم أجر ترك المنهيات بخلاف الثقلين

BURSEVI:v10p45#2/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p45#2/r6.speaker: الكرماني
BURSEVI:v10p45#2/r6.claim: Al-Kirmani asks whether abstention counts as an action; the answer is that refraining needs intention to obey the Law and earn reward, but not merely to avert punishment.
BURSEVI:v10p45#2/r6.anchor: قال الكرماني في شرح البخاري إن قلت التروك أيضا عمل لأن الأصح الترك كف النفس فيحتاج إلى النية

BURSEVI:v10p45#2/r7.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p45#2/r7.speaker: الكرماني
BURSEVI:v10p45#2/r7.claim: The common statement that omissions need no intention applies to merely escaping liability; for reward, one must intend abstention in obedience, as with leaving fornication.
BURSEVI:v10p45#2/r7.anchor: نعم إذا كان المقصود امتثال أمر الشارع وتحصيل الثواب إما في إسقاط العقاب فلا

TABATABAI:66:4-9/r9.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:66:4-9/r9.speaker: author
TABATABAI:66:4-9/r9.claim: The surah repeatedly establishes God's support for the Prophet and rebukes those opposing him; shifts among the Prophet, believers, and wives reveal the episode only after his vindication is secured.
TABATABAI:66:4-9/r9.anchor: ولحن الآيات في إظهار النبي صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم على من يؤذيه

TABATABAI:66:4-9/r14.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:66:4-9/r14.speaker: author
TABATABAI:66:4-9/r14.claim: The passage alternates between believers protecting themselves and families, disbelievers told not to excuse themselves, believers told to repent, and the Prophet told to fight disbelievers and hypocrites.
TABATABAI:66:4-9/r14.anchor: فقال { يا أيها الذين آمنوا قوا أنفسكم وأهليكم } الخ

TABATABAI:66:5-6/r8.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:66:5-6/r8.speaker: author
TABATABAI:66:5-6/r8.claim: Qū is an imperative from wiqāya: to protect something from what harms or injures it.
TABATABAI:66:5-6/r8.anchor: أمر من الوقاية بمعنى حفظ الشيء مما يؤذيه ويضره

TABATABAI:66:5-6/r9.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:66:5-6/r9.speaker: author
TABATABAI:66:5-6/r9.claim: With fatḥa on the wāw, waqūd names the material used to kindle a fire, such as firewood.
TABATABAI:66:5-6/r9.anchor: والوقود بفتح الواو اسم لما توقد به النار من حطب ونحوه

TABATABAI:66:5-6/r10.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:66:5-6/r10.speaker: author
TABATABAI:66:5-6/r10.claim: The fire is Hell; people being its fuel means that they themselves burn in it, as in the cited verse.
TABATABAI:66:5-6/r10.anchor: والمراد بالنار نار جهنم وكون الناس المعذبين فيها وقودا لها معناه اشتعال الناس فيها بأنفسهم

THALABI:v9p349/r7.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v9p349/r7.speaker: author
THALABI:v9p349/r7.claim: To guard one's family from the Fire means commanding good, forbidding evil, teaching them and drawing them near through that instruction.
THALABI:v9p349/r7.anchor: يعني: مروهم بالخير، وانهوهم عن الشر وعلموهم وأدنوهم تقوهم بذلك نارا

THALABI:v9p349/r8.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v9p349/r8.speaker: author
THALABI:v9p349/r8.claim: The Fire is fueled by people and stones; its angels are harsh, powerful keepers, the nineteen wardens and their assistants.
THALABI:v9p349/r8.anchor: وقودها الناس والحجارة عليها ملائكة غلاظ فظاظ شداد أقوياء لم يخلق الله فيهم الرحمة، وهم الزبانية التسعة عشر وأعوانهم من خزنه النار

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#2/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#2/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#2/r1.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās explains protecting yourselves as avoiding what God forbids and doing what He commands.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#2/r1.anchor: قال ابن عباس: أي بالانتهاء عما نهاكم الله عنه، والعمل بطاعته

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#2/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#2/r2.speaker: عمر عن النبي
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#2/r2.claim: ʿUmar asks how to protect one’s family; the Prophet answers: forbid them what God forbids and command them what He commands.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#2/r2.anchor: قال عمر: يا رسول الله: هذا نقي أنفسنا فكيف لنا بأهلينا؟ قال: "تنهونهم

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#2/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#2/r3.speaker: مقاتل بن حيان
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#2/r3.claim: Muqātil b. Ḥayyān says a Muslim must discipline himself and his family, teach good, and forbid evil, including for dependants and enslaved people.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#2/r3.anchor: قال مقاتل بن حيان: يعني أن يؤدب الرجل المسلم نفسه وأهله

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#3/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#3/r1.speaker: علي
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#3/r1.claim: ʿAlī says the verse commands people to teach and discipline their families.

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#3/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#3/r2.speaker: الحسن
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#3/r2.claim: Al-Ḥasan says to command the family to obey God and forbid them to disobey Him.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#3/r2.anchor: وقال الحسن: تأمرهم بطاعة الله وتنهاهم عن معصيته

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#3/r3.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#3/r3.speaker: قتادة
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#3/r3.claim: Qatāda likewise says to command obedience to God and forbid disobedience.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#3/r3.anchor: وقال قتادة: مروهم بطاعة الله، وانهوهم عن معصية الله

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#3/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#3/r4.speaker: ابن عمر
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#3/r4.claim: Ibn ʿUmar tells a man to discipline his child, since the father is accountable for how he raised and taught the child, while the child is accountable for honoring and obeying him.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#3/r4.anchor: قال ابن عمر لرجل: أدب ابنك فإنك مسؤول عن ولدك

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#3/r5.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#3/r5.speaker: أبو ذر عن النبي
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#3/r5.claim: Abū Dharr reports the Prophet advising: be gentle with your family and do not withhold their provision.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#3/r5.anchor: وقال أبو ذر: أوصاني رسول الله -صلى الله عليه وسلم-

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#3/r6.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#3/r6.speaker: أبو إسحاق
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#3/r6.claim: Abū Isḥāq says to direct oneself and one’s family toward what brings one near God and keep them from sins.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#3/r6.anchor: وقال أبو إسحاق: المعنى: خذوا أنفسكم وأهليكم

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#3/r7.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#3/r7.speaker: مقاتل
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#3/r7.claim: Muqātil says good discipline protects the family from sins and the Fire; the author refers to his earlier explanation of the Fire’s fuel in 2:24.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#3/r7.anchor: وقال مقاتل: قوا أنفسكم وأهليكم المعاصي بالأدب الصالح

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#3/r8.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#3/r8.speaker: ابن عباس
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#3/r8.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās identifies the angels over Hell as its nineteen keepers.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#3/r8.anchor: قال ابن عباس: يريد خزنة النار تسعة عشر ملكا

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#3/r9.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#3/r9.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#3/r9.claim: The angels are severe toward Hell’s inhabitants, as in 9:73 and 66:9; alternatively, “severe” can describe their large bodies.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#3/r9.anchor: أي على أهل النار كقوله: {واغلظ عليهم}

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#3/r10.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#3/r10.speaker: ابن عباس ومقاتل
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#3/r10.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says the distance between an angel’s shoulders is a year’s journey; Muqātil gives a similar description.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p22#3/r10.anchor: قال (¬2) ابن عباس: ما بين منكبيه مسيرة سنة

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:66:5-6/r4.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:66:5-6/r4.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:66:5-6/r4.claim: Believers must take themselves and their families toward what brings them near to God and keep themselves and their families from sins.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:66:5-6/r4.anchor: يا أيها الذين آمنوا قوا أنفسكم وأهليكم نارا } أي: خذوا أنفسكم وأهليكم بما يقرب من الله تعالى

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:66:5-6/r5.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:66:5-6/r5.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:66:5-6/r5.claim: People and stones are the two kinds of fuel by which the Fire is kindled.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:66:5-6/r5.anchor: وقودها الناس والحجارة } أي: توقد بهذين الجنسين

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:66:5-6/r6.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:66:5-6/r6.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:66:5-6/r6.claim: The stern, strong angels who never disobey God are the keepers of Hell.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:66:5-6/r6.anchor: عليها ملائكة غلاظ شداد لا يعصون الله ما أمرهم ويفعلون ما يؤمرون } يعني: خزنة جهنم.

QASHANI:66:6/r1.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:66:6/r1.speaker: author
QASHANI:66:6/r1.claim: True family consists of those joined to a person by spiritual attachment and love, whether or not they are physically related.
QASHANI:66:6/r1.anchor: الأهل بالحقيقة هو الذي بينه وبين الرجل تعلق روحاني واتصال عشقي

QASHANI:66:6/r2.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:66:6/r2.speaker: author
QASHANI:66:6/r2.claim: One must protect from Hell every person or power one loves, since spiritually attached companions necessarily accompany one in this life and the next.
QASHANI:66:6/r2.anchor: وكل ما تعلق به تعلقا عشقيا فبالضرورة يكون معه في الدنيا والآخرة

QASHANI:66:6/r3.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:66:6/r3.speaker: author
QASHANI:66:6/r3.claim: Purifying oneself while loving souls immersed in dark traits is not true purification: that attachment draws one to share their abyss and veil, whether they are inner natural powers or other people.
QASHANI:66:6/r3.anchor: وفيه ميل ومحبة لبعض النفوس المنغمسة فيها لم يزكها بالحقيقة

QASHANI:66:6/r4.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:66:6/r4.speaker: author
QASHANI:66:6/r4.claim: A sincere seeker should love the pure and the saints in order to be gathered with them, since a person is resurrected with those they love.
QASHANI:66:6/r4.anchor: ولهذا يجب على الصادق محبة الأصفياء والأولياء ليحشر معهم

QASHANI:66:6/r5.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:66:6/r5.speaker: author
QASHANI:66:6/r5.claim: This is a distinct spiritual fire of divine overpowering, consuming souls tied by love and desire to low concerns and dense earthly bodies.
QASHANI:66:6/r5.anchor: نارا مخصوصة من بين النيران بأن لا تتقد إلا بالناس والحجارة

QASHANI:66:6/r6.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:66:6/r6.speaker: author
QASHANI:66:6/r6.claim: The angels are the heavenly powers active in earthly affairs: the spiritual forces of seven planets and twelve zodiacal signs, signified by the nineteen guardians, apart from Mālik, who represents corporeal nature.
QASHANI:66:6/r6.anchor: وهي القوى السماوية والملكوت الفعالة في الأمور الأرضية

QASHANI:66:6/r7.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:66:6/r7.speaker: author
QASHANI:66:6/r7.claim: If human souls shed bodily entanglements they could rise to the realm of Jabarut and influence these powers; immersion in bodily matter instead leaves them affected, captive, and tormented by them.
QASHANI:66:6/r7.anchor: لو تجردت هذه النفوس الإنسانية ترقت من مراتبها واتصلت بعالم الجبروت

QASHANI:66:6/r8.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:66:6/r8.speaker: author
QASHANI:66:6/r8.claim: The angels are severe and strong, without gentleness or mercy, because they are constituted for overpowering and take pleasure only in it.
QASHANI:66:6/r8.anchor: أي: أقوياء لا لين ولا رأفة ولا رحمة فيهم

QASHANI:66:6/r9.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:66:6/r9.speaker: author
QASHANI:66:6/r9.claim: Their submission makes them obedient: although they overpower lower-world bodies and forces, they are themselves overpowered by the Divine Presence; this innate obedience enables their worldly effects.
QASHANI:66:6/r9.anchor: لأنهم وإن كانوا قهارين مؤثرين بالنسبة إلى ما تحتهم من أجرام هذا العالم

QASHANI:66:6/r10.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:66:6/r10.speaker: author
QASHANI:66:6/r10.claim: They carry out their commands through continuous influence and unending power.
QASHANI:66:6/r10.anchor: لدوام تأثيرهم وعدم تناهي قواهم وقدرهم

ELMALILI:66:6/r1.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:66:6/r1.speaker: author
ELMALILI:66:6/r1.claim: Protecting oneself and family from the Fire means guarding them against sins and temptations that lead there and directing them to God’s commands and obedience.
ELMALILI:66:6/r1.anchor: cehennem ateşine sürüklenmelerine sebep olacak fitne ve isyandan koruyarak Allah’ın emirlerine, tâate sevkedin

ELMALILI:66:6/r2.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:66:6/r2.speaker: author
ELMALILI:66:6/r2.claim: A household head is accountable for both himself and his family, as expressed by two well-known Prophetic hadiths about shepherding and being best to one’s family.
ELMALILI:66:6/r2.anchor: aile sâhibi kendinden mes’ul olduğu gibi ailesinden de mes’uldür.

ELMALILI:66:6/r3.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:66:6/r3.speaker: عمر
ELMALILI:66:6/r3.claim: Abu Hayyan reports that Umar asked the Messenger how people could protect their families; the Prophet replied to forbid them what God forbids and command them what He commands.
ELMALILI:66:6/r3.anchor: Hazret-i Ömer “yâ Resûlullah! Nefislerimizi vikāye ederiz, fakat ehillerimizi nasıl vikāye edebiliriz?” demişti

ELMALILI:66:6/r4.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:66:6/r4.speaker: Keşşâf
ELMALILI:66:6/r4.claim: Al-Kashshaf records a report urging the family to keep up prayer, fasting, zakat, and care for the poor, orphans, and neighbors, hoping God will gather them in Paradise.
ELMALILI:66:6/r4.anchor: Keşşâf’ta da şu hadisleri kayd eylemiştir:

ELMALILI:66:6/r5.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:66:6/r5.speaker: author
ELMALILI:66:6/r5.claim: Children are included in ahl; some also include them in anfus because a child is a part of its father.

ELMALILI:66:6/r6.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:66:6/r6.speaker: author
ELMALILI:66:6/r6.claim: The Fire’s fuel of people and stones is also stated in al-Baqara 2:24.
ELMALILI:66:6/r6.anchor: yakacağı o insanlar ve o taşlardır (Sûre-i Bakara’da

ELMALILI:66:6/r7.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:66:6/r7.speaker: author
ELMALILI:66:6/r7.claim: The harsh, powerful angels assigned to the Fire are called zabāniya; their severity is directed at Hell’s inhabitants because God commanded it.
ELMALILI:66:6/r7.anchor: Ki bunlara “zebânî” denilir. Bunların gılzatları ve şiddetleri ehl-i cehenneme karşıdır.

ELMALILI:66:6/r8.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:66:6/r8.speaker: author
ELMALILI:66:6/r8.claim: All angels obey God without opposition and carry out whatever they are commanded.
ELMALILI:66:6/r8.anchor: Onlarda Allah’ın emrine isyan ve muhalefet olmaz, kendilerine her ne emrolunursa onu icrâ ederler.

ELMALILI:66:6/r9.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:66:6/r9.speaker: author
ELMALILI:66:6/r9.claim: After this warning, the discourse turns to address the unbelievers.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:66:6/r1.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:66:6/r1.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:66:6/r1.claim: The warning about believers' family responsibility follows an example from the Prophet's private life; a Muslim's spiritual responsibility extends beyond personal life.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:66:6/r1.anchor: Hz. Peygamber’in özel hayatından verilen örnek ışığında müminlerin aile sorumluluğuyla ilgili bir uyarı yapılmaktadır

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:66:6/r2.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:66:6/r2.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:66:6/r2.claim: Though the scope of family varies with social structure, this responsibility naturally supports a strongly bonded family, not only spiritual aims.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:66:6/r2.anchor: bir müslümanın mânevî mesuliyetinin sırf kişisel hayatıyla sınırlı olmadığına dikkat etmesinin gerekliliğidir

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:66:6/r3.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:66:6/r3.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:66:6/r3.claim: The fire in the verse refers to hell; the commentary directs readers to the explanation of its human and stone fuel in 2:24.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:66:6/r3.anchor: Âyette zikredilen ateşten maksat cehennem ateşidir

QUSHAYRI:v3p333/r6.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p333/r6.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p333/r6.claim: Protecting one's family means teaching understanding, disciplining them, calling them to obedience, and guiding them so they do not deserve punishment; this establishes enjoining right with nearest kin first.
QUSHAYRI:v3p333/r6.anchor: فقهوهم ، وأدبوهم ، وادعوهم إلى طاعة الله ، وامنعوهم عن استحقاق العقوبة بإرشادهم وتعليمهم . ودلت الآية : على وجوب الأمر بالمعروف في الدين

QUSHAYRI:v3p333/r7.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p333/r7.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p333/r7.claim: One application is to model worship so family members learn it and make it their habit.
QUSHAYRI:v3p333/r7.anchor: وقيل : أظهرا من أنفسكم العبادات ليتعلموا منكم ، ويعتادوا كعادتكم

QUSHAYRI:v3p333/r8.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p333/r8.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p333/r8.claim: Another application is to direct one's family to the Sunna and community.

QUSHAYRI:v3p333/r9.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p333/r9.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p333/r9.claim: Another application is to teach them good character.

QUSHAYRI:v3p333/r10.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p333/r10.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p333/r10.claim: Another application is to command them to accept sincere advice.

QUSHAYRI:v3p333/r12.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p333/r12.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p333/r12.claim: A wordplay says human affairs may be set right by a stone or clod because humans originate from earth; the author prays to be made a stone instead and saved from the Fire.
QUSHAYRI:v3p333/r12.anchor: أمر الناس يصلح بحجرة أومدرة ، فإن أصل الإنسان مدرة ، ولو أنه أقام حجرة مقام مدرة فلا غرو من فضل الله

BURHAN:v2p64/r2.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v2p64/r2.speaker: author
BURHAN:v2p64/r2.claim: The Meccan verse uses an indefinite “fire” because its later description was not yet familiar; the Medinan Baqarah verse uses the definite article for the fire already introduced.
BURHAN:v2p64/r2.anchor: لأنها نزلت بمكة قبل آية البقرة فلم تكن النار التي وقودها الناس والحجارة معروفة

SULAMI:v2p336#3/r1.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p336#3/r1.speaker: سهل
SULAMI:v2p336#3/r1.claim: Protect yourselves and your families through obedience to God and following the Prophetic practice.
SULAMI:v2p336#3/r1.anchor: قال سهل : بطاعة الله واتباع السنن

SULAMI:v2p336#3/r2.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p336#3/r2.speaker: ابن عطاء
SULAMI:v2p336#3/r2.claim: Protection includes accepting the advice of those who counsel you.
SULAMI:v2p336#3/r2.anchor: وقال ابن عطاء : بقبول نصيحة الناصحين

SULAMI:v2p336#3/r3.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p336#3/r3.speaker: أبو عثمان
SULAMI:v2p336#3/r3.claim: People are commanded to listen to admonitions, accept them, and act on them.
SULAMI:v2p336#3/r3.anchor: قال أبو عثمان : امرنا باستماع المواعظ وقبولها والعمل بها

SULAMI:v2p336#3/r4.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p336#3/r4.speaker: أبو الحسن الوراق
SULAMI:v2p336#3/r4.claim: Teach family members the obligatory duties and Prophetic practices to save them from the Fire.
SULAMI:v2p336#3/r4.anchor: قال أبو الحسن الوراق : علموهم الفرائض والسنن لتنقذوهم بها من النار

SULAMI:v2p336#3/r5.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p336#3/r5.speaker: يحيى
SULAMI:v2p336#3/r5.claim: The Fire is so severe that even iron would not withstand it; its inhabitants cannot sleep, rest from calamity, receive consolation, or offer excuses.
SULAMI:v2p336#3/r5.anchor: وقال يحيى : قوا أنفسكم وأهليكم نارا يا أيها الناس النار التي لو اعدت للحديد لم يقم لها

SULAMI:v2p336#3/r6.author: al-Sulamī
SULAMI:v2p336#3/r6.speaker: القاسم
SULAMI:v2p336#3/r6.claim: Adorn yourselves with acts of obedience and make your families adhere to them, so that they may be sheltered from the Fire.
SULAMI:v2p336#3/r6.anchor: قال القاسم : زينوا أنفسكم بالطاعات واحملوا عليها اهاليكم ليستتروا بها عن النار

ITQAN:v2p546/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v2p546/r1.speaker: الكرماني
ITQAN:v2p546/r1.claim: Al-Kirmani parses أهليكم as a comitative object: protect yourselves together with your families from the Fire.
ITQAN:v2p546/r1.anchor: قال الكرماني في غرائب التفسير هو مفعول معه أي مع أهليكم

ITQAN:v3p199/r2.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v3p199/r2.speaker: الطيبي
ITQAN:v3p199/r2.claim: The angels’ not disobeying God is reinforced by the reciprocal positive statement that they do what they are commanded; al-Suyuti says this device contrasts with ellipsis by implication.
ITQAN:v3p199/r2.anchor: قلت وهذا النوع يقابله في الإيجاز نوع الاحتباك

TUSTARI:66:6/r1.author: Sahl al-Tustarī
TUSTARI:66:6/r1.speaker: author
TUSTARI:66:6/r1.claim: Protect yourselves and your families from the Fire through obedience to God and following the Prophetic practice.

RUMMANI:v1p85/r1.author: al-Rummānī
RUMMANI:v1p85/r1.speaker: author
RUMMANI:v1p85/r1.claim: Metaphor transfers an expression from its original lexical sense to another for clarification; unlike simile, it does not retain an explicit comparison particle.
RUMMANI:v1p85/r1.anchor: الاستعارة تليق العبارة على غير ما وضعت له في أصل اللغة على جهة النقل للإبانة.

RUMMANI:v1p85/r2.author: al-Rummānī
RUMMANI:v1p85/r2.speaker: author
RUMMANI:v1p85/r2.claim: A metaphor has a borrowed expression, its intended referent, and the source from which the expression is borrowed; eloquent metaphor joins two things by a shared feature, like simile but with the word transferred.
RUMMANI:v1p85/r2.anchor: وكل استعارة فلابد فيها من أشياء: مستعار ومستعار له , ومستعار منه.

RUMMANI:v1p85/r3.author: al-Rummānī
RUMMANI:v1p85/r3.speaker: author
RUMMANI:v1p85/r3.claim: A good metaphor clarifies something that literal wording cannot convey; if the literal expression supplied the same clarification, it would be preferable and metaphor would be unnecessary.
RUMMANI:v1p85/r3.anchor: وكل استعارة حسنة فهي توجب بيان لا تنوب منابه الحقيقة

RUMMANI:v1p85/r4.author: al-Rummānī
RUMMANI:v1p85/r4.speaker: author
RUMMANI:v1p85/r4.claim: Every metaphor rests on a literal linguistic basis and adds a clarification inaccessible to literal wording; Imruʾ al-Qays's قيد الأوابد is stronger than literally calling his horse a preventer of game.
RUMMANI:v1p85/r4.anchor: كقول امرئ القيس في صفة الفرس: " قيد الأوابد " والحقيقة فيه: مانع الأوابد

RUMMANI:v1p85/r5.author: al-Rummānī
RUMMANI:v1p85/r5.speaker: author
RUMMANI:v1p85/r5.claim: Calling reasoning a scale means calibrating it; the metaphor is more eloquent than the literal expression because a balance is perceptible whereas calibration is not.
RUMMANI:v1p85/r5.anchor: كقولك: ميزان القياس , حقيقة تعديل القياس

DAMGHANI:v1p116/r13.author: al-Dāmghānī
DAMGHANI:v1p116/r13.speaker: author
DAMGHANI:v1p116/r13.claim: The stones used as Hell's fuel can mean sulfur stones.

DAMGHANI:v1p116/r14.author: al-Dāmghānī
DAMGHANI:v1p116/r14.speaker: ابن مسعود
DAMGHANI:v1p116/r14.claim: Ibn Masʿūd says the stones are sulfur, which God made an admonition as He willed.
DAMGHANI:v1p116/r14.anchor: قال ابن مسعود حجارة من كبريت جعلها الله تعالى عبرة كما شاء

IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p473/r1.author: Ibn Qutayba
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p473/r1.speaker: author
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p473/r1.claim: Protect yourselves from the Fire by obeying God and His Messenger.
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p473/r1.anchor: قوله: {قوا أنفسكم وأهليكم نارا} أي قوا أنفسكم النار: بطاعة الله ورسوله

IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p473/r2.author: Ibn Qutayba
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p473/r2.speaker: author
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p473/r2.claim: Protect your families by teaching them and requiring them to follow what will save them from the Fire.
IBNQUTAYBA-GHARIB:v1p473/r2.anchor: وقوا أهليكم النار: بتعليمهم وأخذهم بما ينجيهم منها

NAHHAS:v4p461/r16.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p461/r16.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v4p461/r16.claim: All grammarians derive the verb from وقى يقي, whose underlying form is وقى يوقي.
NAHHAS:v4p461/r16.anchor: الفعل من هذا وقى يقي عند جميع النحويين والأصل عندهم وقى يوقي

NAHHAS:v4p461/r17.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p461/r17.speaker: البصريون
NAHHAS:v4p461/r17.claim: Basrans say wāw was deleted because it was vowelless between yāʾ and kasra; it remains in يؤجل because fatḥa follows.
NAHHAS:v4p461/r17.anchor: قال البصريون حذفت الواو لوقوعها بين ياء وكسرة وهي ساكنة ولم تحذف في يؤجل

NAHHAS:v4p461/r18.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p461/r18.speaker: الكوفيون
NAHHAS:v4p461/r18.claim: Kufans say wāw is deleted in transitive verbs but retained in intransitives, as in وعد يعد versus وجل يوجل.
NAHHAS:v4p461/r18.anchor: وقال الكوفيون حذفت الواو للفعل المتعدي وأثبت في اللازم فرقا

NAHHAS:v4p461/r19.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p461/r19.speaker: البصريون
NAHHAS:v4p461/r19.claim: Basrans answer with وسع يسع and ولغ يلغ; وسع was originally وسع يوسع, with its vowel change caused by a guttural.
NAHHAS:v4p461/r19.anchor: والاحتجاج للبصريين أن الأصل وسع يوسع وحذفت الواو لما تقدم

NAHHAS:v4p461/r20.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p461/r20.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v4p461/r20.claim: The intransitive ورم يرم clearly refutes the Kufan rule; يثق is another counterexample, so the author sides with the Basran rebuttal.
NAHHAS:v4p461/r20.anchor: قال أبو جعفر وهذا رد بين ولو جاء قوا على الأصل لكان ايقيوا

NAHHAS:v4p461/r21.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p461/r21.speaker: سيبويه
NAHHAS:v4p461/r21.claim: Sibawayh says the reflexive construction is expressed separately, as in أكرم نفسك, rather than أكرمك.
NAHHAS:v4p461/r21.anchor: فقول سيبويه لأنهم استغنوا عنه بقولهم أكرم نفسك

NAHHAS:v4p461/r22.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p461/r22.speaker: محمد بن يزيد
NAHHAS:v4p461/r22.claim: Al-Mubarrad says the alternative is impossible because one thing cannot be agent and patient at once.
NAHHAS:v4p461/r22.anchor: وقال محمد بن يزيد لم يجز هذا لأنه لا يكون الشيء فاعلا مفعولا في حال

NAHHAS:v4p461/r23.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p461/r23.speaker: الكوفيون
NAHHAS:v4p461/r23.claim: Kufans inconsistently reject the construction yet cite Arab usage عدمتني; Basrans reject all such forms.
NAHHAS:v4p461/r23.anchor: فأما الكوفيون فخلطوا في هذه فمرة يقولون لا يجوز كما يقول البصريون

NAHHAS:v4p461/r24.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p461/r24.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v4p461/r24.claim: أهليكم is accusative by coordination with أنفسكم.
NAHHAS:v4p461/r24.anchor: وأهليكم في موضع نصب معطوف على أنفسكم

NAHHAS:v4p461/r25.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p461/r25.speaker: الفراء
NAHHAS:v4p461/r25.claim: Al-Farrāʾ explains the kasra in the accusative by yāʾ marking the case, as in رأيت الزيدين, with nūn dropped in annexation.
NAHHAS:v4p461/r25.anchor: فالجواب أن الياء علامة النصب كقولك رأيت الزيدين وحذفت النون للإضافة

NAHHAS:v4p461/r26.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p461/r26.speaker: الفراء
NAHHAS:v4p461/r26.claim: Al-Farrāʾ reports that some Arabs use أهله for a feminine referent.
NAHHAS:v4p461/r26.anchor: وحكى الفراء أن من العرب من يقول أهله في المؤنث

NAHHAS:v4p461/r27.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p461/r27.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v4p461/r27.claim: نارا is the second object of قوا.

NAHHAS:v4p461/r28.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p461/r28.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v4p461/r28.claim: وقودها is the subject and الناس its predicate; the clause is an adjective of النار in accusative position.
NAHHAS:v4p461/r28.anchor: وقودها الناس ) مبتدأ وخبره في موضع نصب نعت للنار

NAHHAS:v4p461/r30.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p461/r30.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v4p461/r30.claim: The angels are harsh toward sinners and severe toward them.
NAHHAS:v4p461/r30.anchor: عليها ملائكة غلاظ شداد ) أي غلاظ على العصاة أشداء عليهم

NAHHAS:v4p461/r31.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p461/r31.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v4p461/r31.claim: Another gloss takes شداد to mean strong and powerful.

NAHHAS:v4p461/r32.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p461/r32.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v4p461/r32.claim: ما أمرهم has two objects with a preposition elided: they do not disobey God concerning what He commands.
NAHHAS:v4p461/r32.anchor: لا يعصون الله ما أمرهم ) مفعولان على حذف الحرف أي فيما أمرهم

NAHHAS:v4p461/r33.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v4p461/r33.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v4p461/r33.claim: If ما is relative, its returning pronoun is omitted; if verbal noun, no pronoun is needed.
NAHHAS:v4p461/r33.anchor: وحذف المضمر الذي يعود على ما وإن جعلتها مصدرا لم تحتج إلى عائد

SAMIN-DURR:66:6/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:66:6/r1.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:66:6/r1.claim: قوا derives from الوقاية: the initial radical drops between yāʾ and kasra, then other deletions follow by analogy with the jussive; this is the Basran derivation.
SAMIN-DURR:66:6/r1.anchor: لأن الفاء حذفت لوقوعها في المضارع بين ياء وكسرة، وهذا محمول عليه، واللام حذفت حملا له على المجزوم

SAMIN-DURR:66:6/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:66:6/r2.speaker: الكوفيون
SAMIN-DURR:66:6/r2.claim: The Kufans say initial waw drops in transitive يقي and يعد to distinguish them from intransitives.
SAMIN-DURR:66:6/r2.anchor: ونقل مكي عن الكوفيين: أن الحذف عندهم فرقا بين المتعدي والقاصر

SAMIN-DURR:66:6/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:66:6/r3.speaker: مكي
SAMIN-DURR:66:6/r3.claim: Makki objects that the Kufan rule fails for intransitive يرم, which also loses its initial radical.
SAMIN-DURR:66:6/r3.anchor: ونقل مكي عن الكوفيين: أن الحذف عندهم فرقا بين المتعدي والقاصر فحذفت الواو التي هي فاء

SAMIN-DURR:66:6/r4.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:66:6/r4.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:66:6/r4.claim: The author replies that يوجل does not put waw between yāʾ and kasra, overtly or implicitly; this also distinguishes يضع and يسع.
SAMIN-DURR:66:6/r4.anchor: قلت: وفي هذا نظر؛ لأن يوجل لم تقع فيه الواو بين ياء وكسرة لا ظاهرة ولا مضمرة

SAMIN-DURR:66:6/r5.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:66:6/r5.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:66:6/r5.claim: نارا is the second object; وقودها الناس and عليها ملائكة describe the Fire, while عليها can be a modifier with ملائكة as subject or clauses can be circumstantial.
SAMIN-DURR:66:6/r5.anchor: مفعول ثان. و { وقودها الناس } صفة ل " نارا " وكذلك " عليها ملائكة "

SAMIN-DURR:66:6/r6.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:66:6/r6.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:66:6/r6.claim: Some read وأهلوكم, coordinating it with قوا’s subject pronoun; the object separates the coordination.
SAMIN-DURR:66:6/r6.anchor: وقرأ بعضهم " وأهلوكم " وخرجت على العطف على الضمير المرفوع ب " قوا "

SAMIN-DURR:66:6/r7.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:66:6/r7.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:66:6/r7.claim: Al-Zamakhsharī says the coordinated subject and object stay together and second person prevails for the combined addressees, not وليق أهلوكم أنفسكم.
SAMIN-DURR:66:6/r7.anchor: ولكن المعطوف في التقدير مقارن للواو، و " أنفسكم " واقع بعده

SAMIN-DURR:66:6/r8.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:66:6/r8.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:66:6/r8.claim: The author points back to discussion in al-Baqara about whether the wāw in وقود has ḍamma or fatḥa.
SAMIN-DURR:66:6/r8.anchor: وتقدم الخلاف في واو " وقود " ضما وفتحا في البقرة.

SAMIN-DURR:66:6#2/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:66:6#2/r1.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:66:6#2/r1.claim: ما can be relative with omitted prepositional return, originally ما أمرهم به; omission leaves the gap accusative.
SAMIN-DURR:66:6#2/r1.anchor: يجوز أن تكون " ما " بمعنى الذي، والعائد محذوف أي ما أمرهموه،

SAMIN-DURR:66:6#2/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:66:6#2/r2.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:66:6#2/r2.claim: Alternatively, ما is a verbal noun in the position of inclusive apposition to God’s name, meaning لا يعصون أمره.
SAMIN-DURR:66:6#2/r2.anchor: وأن تكون مصدرية، ويكون محلها بدلا من اسم الله بدل اشتمال

SAMIN-DURR:66:6#2/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:66:6#2/r3.speaker: الزمخشري
SAMIN-DURR:66:6#2/r3.claim: Al-Zamakhsharī distinguishes accepting and keeping commands from carrying them out without slowness or neglect.
SAMIN-DURR:66:6#2/r3.anchor: قال الزمخشري: " فإن قلت: أليست الجملتان في معنى واحد؟ قلت: لا؛ لأن الأولى معناها

ZAJJAJ:v5p193#2/r5.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p193#2/r5.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p193#2/r5.claim: Protect yourselves and your families by doing what draws you near to God and keeping yourselves and them away from sins.
ZAJJAJ:v5p193#2/r5.anchor: خذوا أنفسكم وأهليكم بما يقرب من الله - جل وعز -

ZAJJAJ:v5p193#2/r6.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p193#2/r6.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p193#2/r6.claim: An exegetical exhortation urges a man to attend to his family's prayer, fasting, and care for the poor, orphan, and neighbors; this means maintaining these duties and fulfilling God's obligations in them.
ZAJJAJ:v5p193#2/r6.anchor: جاء في التفسير: رحم الله رجلا قال: يا أهلاه صلاتكم

ZAJJAJ:v5p193#2/r7.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p193#2/r7.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p193#2/r7.claim: A hadith says that God may gather the family together with the man in Paradise.
ZAJJAJ:v5p193#2/r7.anchor: وفي الحديث لعل الله يجمعهم معه في الجنة

ZAJJAJ:v5p194/r1.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p194/r1.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p194/r1.claim: Exegetes identify the stones that fuel the fire as sulfur stones.
ZAJJAJ:v5p194/r1.anchor: جاء في التفسير أنها حجارة الكبريت

ZAJJAJ:v5p194/r2.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p194/r2.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p194/r2.claim: With fatḥa on wāw, waqūd means the material used to kindle a fire, such as firewood; with ḍamma, wuqūd names the fire's burning.
ZAJJAJ:v5p194/r2.anchor: والوقود بفتح الواو ما توقد به النار من حطب وغيره

ASAD-NOTES:66:intro/r1.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:66:intro/r1.speaker: Asad
ASAD-NOTES:66:intro/r1.claim: Asad dates the surah to the second half of the Medina period, probably 7 AH.
ASAD-NOTES:66:intro/r1.anchor: REVEALED in the second half of the Medina period - probably in 7 H.

ASAD-NOTES:66:intro/r2.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:66:intro/r2.speaker: Zamakhshari
ASAD-NOTES:66:intro/r2.claim: Zamakhshari records the alternate title 'Surah of the Prophet', since its first half concerns aspects of Muhammad's personal and family life.
ASAD-NOTES:66:intro/r2.anchor: occasionally designated as "The Surah of the Prophet" (Zamakhshari) inasmuch as the first half

ASAD-NOTES:66:6#n11/r1.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:66:6#n11/r1.speaker: Asad
ASAD-NOTES:66:6#n11/r1.claim: Ahl literally means family or people, but can include people sharing race, religion, or occupation, and dependants in the broadest sense.
ASAD-NOTES:66:6#n11/r1.anchor: the term ahl denotes also people who share one's race, religion, occupation, etc., as well as "dependants"

ASAD-NOTES:66:6#n12/r1.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:66:6#n12/r1.speaker: Asad
ASAD-NOTES:66:6#n12/r1.claim: Asad refers to his explanation of the fire's fuel at 2:24.

ASAD-NOTES:66:6#n13/r1.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:66:6#n13/r1.speaker: Asad
ASAD-NOTES:66:6#n13/r1.claim: Asad refers readers to his allegorical explanation of the passage about Hell's keepers at 74:27 and following.
ASAD-NOTES:66:6#n13/r1.anchor: See 74:27 ff. and the corresponding notes, particularly notes 15 and 16

ASAD-NOTES:66:6#n14/r1.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:66:6#n14/r1.speaker: Asad
ASAD-NOTES:66:6#n14/r1.claim: The angels are subject to God's law of cause and effect, which governs the spiritual realm as it does the material world.
ASAD-NOTES:66:6#n14/r1.anchor: these angelic powers are subject to the God-willed law of cause and effect which dominates the realm of the spirit no less than the world of matter

SAMARRAI-ASRAR-MUH:p24/r2.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-ASRAR-MUH:p24/r2.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-ASRAR-MUH:p24/r2.claim: The Qur’an consistently uses masculine forms for nominal descriptions of angels, illustrated by several descriptions.
SAMARRAI-ASRAR-MUH:p24/r2.anchor: كل وصف إسمي للملائكة يأتي بالتذكير (الملائكة المقرّبون) (الملائكة باسطوا أيديهم)

SAMARRAI-ASRAR-MUH:p24/r3.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-ASRAR-MUH:p24/r3.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-ASRAR-MUH:p24/r3.claim: Worship actions take masculine forms because masculine worship is more complete than feminine worship; the messengers were therefore all men.
SAMARRAI-ASRAR-MUH:p24/r3.anchor: كل فعل عبادة يأتي بالتذكير (فسجد الملائكة كلهم أجمعين) (لا يعصون الله ما أمرهم)

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p474/r1.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p474/r1.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p474/r1.claim: When worship expands and becomes more general, the author says the masculine verb and lam in the oath response suit it; the narrower first case used qad and a feminine verb.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p474/r1.anchor: فعندما اتسعت العبادة وصارت أعمّ وأوسع من الأولى ذكّر وجاء باللام

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p474/r2.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p474/r2.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p474/r2.claim: A broken plural permits either masculine or feminine agreement, as shown by masculine angels in Sad and feminine agreement in Aal Imran.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p474/r2.anchor: يمكن أن يؤنّث الفعل أو يُذكّر إذا كان الجمع جمع تكسير

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p474/r3.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p474/r3.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p474/r3.claim: Angel worship verbs take masculine agreement; the author says masculine worship is more complete and notes that all messengers were men.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p474/r3.anchor: لأن المذكر في العبادة أكمل من عبادة الأنثى ولذلك جاء الرسل كلهم رجالاً.

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p642/r1.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p642/r1.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p642/r1.claim: Commands addressed to angels consistently use masculine forms, including اسجدوا, أنبئوني, and فقعوا له ساجدين.

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p642/r2.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p642/r2.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p642/r2.claim: Verbs following mention of the angels are masculine, as in their entering, witnessing, and glorifying God.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p642/r2.anchor: كل فعل يقع بعد ذكر الملائكة يأتي بالتذكير أيضاً

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p642/r3.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p642/r3.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p642/r3.claim: Nominal descriptions of angels use masculine forms, including al-muqarrabun, basitu aydihim, musawwimin, murdifin, and munzilin.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p642/r3.anchor: كل وصف إسمي للملائكة يأتي بالتذكير

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p642/r4.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p642/r4.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p642/r4.claim: Acts of angel worship use masculine forms; the author says masculine worship is more complete and that the messengers were all men.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p642/r4.anchor: لأن المذكر في العبادة أكمل من عبادة الأنثى ولذلك جاء الرسل كلهم رجالاً.

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p642/r5.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p642/r5.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p642/r5.claim: Strength and severity favor masculine forms, especially for the harsher of two punishments; the author contrasts masculine yatwaffa with feminine tawaffat and also compares forms of tanzil.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p642/r5.anchor: كل أمر فيه شِدّة وقوة حتى لو كان عذابين أحدهما أشدّ من الآخر فالأشدّ يأتي بالتذكير

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p642/r6.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p642/r6.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p642/r6.claim: Qur'anic glad tidings from angels never use masculine agreement; they always come in feminine forms such as fanadathu and qalati al-malaika.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p642/r6.anchor: لم تأت بشرى بصيغة التذكير أبداً في القرآن الكريم فكل بشارة في القرآن الكريم تأتي بصيغة التأنيث

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p376/r2.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p376/r2.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p376/r2.claim: The passage moves from correcting the Prophet and his wives to urging all Muslims to guard their families against the Hereafter's punishment.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p376/r2.anchor: After checking the Prophet (sws) and his wives, general Muslims are urged to continually check and restrain their near ones

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p376/r3.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p376/r3.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p376/r3.claim: Muslims must continually check and restrain their close family members to save themselves from punishment in the Hereafter.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p376/r3.anchor: continually check and restrain their near ones in order to save themselves from the punishment of the Hereafter.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p376/r4.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p376/r4.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p376/r4.claim: Hell's guardian angels are strict and stern and will show no lenience.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-8-english:p376/r4.anchor: the angels who guard Hell are strict and stern. They shall show no lenience to any one.

ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p303/r1.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Ṣanʿānī
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p303/r1.speaker: قتادة
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p303/r1.claim: Qatāda explains protecting oneself and one's family from the Fire as commanding them to obey God and forbidding them to disobey Him.
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p303/r1.anchor: عن قتادة في قوله ﴿ قوا أنفسكم وأهليكم نارا ﴾ قال مروهم بطاعة الله وانهوهم عن معصية الله

ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p303/r2.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Ṣanʿānī
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p303/r2.speaker: علي بن أبي طالب
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p303/r2.claim: ʿAlī explains the command as teaching oneself and one's family what is good.
ABDURRAZZAQ:v3p303/r2.anchor: عن علي في قوله تعالى ﴿ قوا أنفسكم وأهليكم نارا ﴾ قال علي بن أبي طالب علموا أنفسكم وأهليكم الخير

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r1.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r1.claim: The special admonition to the Prophet’s wives is followed by a general admonition for believers and their families.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r1.anchor: ولما وعظ أزواج الرسول صلى الله عليه وسلم موعظة خاصة، أتبع ذلك بموعظة عامة للمؤمنين وأهليهم

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r2.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r2.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r2.claim: The household is joined to the self because the head of the home is its caretaker and accountable for it.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r2.anchor: وعطف وأهليكم على أنفسكم، لأن رب المنزل راع وهو مسؤول عن أهله

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r3.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r3.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r3.claim: Protecting one’s family means making them obey God and requiring their obligations.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r3.anchor: ومعنى وقايتهم: حملهم على طاعته وإلزامهم أداء ما فرض عليهم

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r4.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r4.speaker: عمر
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r4.claim: ʿUmar asked how to protect families; the Prophet said to forbid what God forbids and command what He commands, shielding them from Hell.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r4.anchor: قال عمر: يا رسول الله، نقي أنفسنا، فكيف لنا بأهلينا؟

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r5.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r5.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r5.claim: Children are included among one’s household.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r6.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r6.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r6.claim: Another view includes children in “yourselves,” since a child is part of the father; he teaches lawful and unlawful matters and keeps the child from sin.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r6.anchor: وقيل: دخلوا في أنفسكم لأن الولد بعض من أبيه، فيعلمه الحلال والحرام ويجنبه المعاصي.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r7.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r7.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r7.claim: A reading with wāw in ahlūkum coordinates it with the pronoun in qū; the object’s separation makes the coordination sound.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r7.anchor: وقرىء: وأهلوكم بالواو، وهو معطوف على الضمير في قوا وحسن العطف للفصل بالمفعول.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r8.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r8.speaker: الزمخشري
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r8.claim: Al-Zamakhsharī parses the joined subject as “you and your families protect yourselves,” not as a separate implied command to the family.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r8.anchor: ولكن المعطوف مقارن في التقدير للواو وأنفسكم واقع بعده، فكأنه قيل: قوا أنتم وأهلوكم أنفسكم.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r9.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r9.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r9.claim: Abū Ḥayyān says al-Zamakhsharī contradicts himself: first he uses a separate verb because an explicit noun cannot be raised by the addressee’s imperative.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r9.anchor: وناقض في قوله هذا لأنه قدر وليق أهلوكم فجعله من عطف الجمل

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r10.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r10.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r10.claim: A prior discussion notes the vowel variation in waqūd under the corresponding verse in al-Baqara.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r10.anchor: وتقدم الخلاف في فتح الواو في قوله: وقودها وضمها في البقرة.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r11.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r11.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r11.claim: The people and stones fuel Hell; its guardians are the nineteen Zabāniya and their assistants.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r11.anchor: وتفسير وقودها الناس والحجارة في البقرة عليها ملائكة: هي الزبانية التسعة عشر وأعوانهم.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r12.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r12.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r12.claim: The guardians are physically massive and strong, or harsh in manner, with no tenderness or compassion toward sinners.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r12.anchor: ووصفهم بالغلظ، إما لشدة أجسامهم وقوتها، وإما لفظاظتهم لقوله: ولو كنت فظا غليظ القلب

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r13.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r13.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r13.claim: Mā amarahum may be an appositive meaning “His command,” as in 20:93, or may have an omitted preposition: “in what He commanded.”
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r13.anchor: وانتصب ما أمرهم على البدل، أي لا يعصون أمره

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r14.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r14.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r14.claim: Some call the last clause emphasis; al-Zamakhsharī distinguishes accepting commands without refusal from carrying them out without delay.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p212/r14.anchor: قيل: كرر المعنى توكيدا. وقال الزمخشري: فإن قلت: أليس الجملتان في معنى واحد؟

ALUSI-FULL:v28p156/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v28p156/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v28p156/r1.claim: Protecting oneself from the Fire means avoiding sins and performing duties; protecting one’s family means guiding them through advice and discipline.
ALUSI-FULL:v28p156/r1.anchor: ووقاية النفس عن النار بترك المعاصي وفعل الطاعات ووقاية الأهل بحملهم على ذلك بالنصح والتأديب

ALUSI-FULL:v28p156/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v28p156/r2.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
ALUSI-FULL:v28p156/r2.claim: When Umar asked how to protect his family, the Prophet answered: forbid them what God forbade and command them what He commanded.
ALUSI-FULL:v28p156/r2.anchor: يا رسول الله نقي أنفسنا فكيف لنا بأهلينا فقال عليه الصلاة والسلام

ALUSI-FULL:v28p156/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v28p156/r3.speaker: علي
ALUSI-FULL:v28p156/r3.claim: Ali glossed the command as teaching one’s family good and disciplining them; Ibn al-Mundhir, al-Hakim (who authenticated it), and others transmit it.
ALUSI-FULL:v28p156/r3.anchor: عن علي كرم الله تعالى وجهه أنه قال

ALUSI-FULL:v28p156/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v28p156/r4.speaker: قيل
ALUSI-FULL:v28p156/r4.claim: The family addressed includes wives, children, male slaves, and female slaves.
ALUSI-FULL:v28p156/r4.anchor: والمراد على ما قيل : ما يشمل الزوجة والولد والعبد والأمة

ALUSI-FULL:v28p156/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v28p156/r5.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v28p156/r5.claim: The verse is evidence that a man must learn the obligatory duties and teach them to those under his care.
ALUSI-FULL:v28p156/r5.anchor: واستدل بها على أنه يجب على الرجل تعلم ما يجب من الفرائض وتعليمه لهؤلاء

ALUSI-FULL:v28p156/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v28p156/r6.speaker: قيل
ALUSI-FULL:v28p156/r6.claim: Some include children within أنفسكم because a child is part of his father.
ALUSI-FULL:v28p156/r6.anchor: وأدخل بعضهم الأولاد في الأنفس لأن الولد بعض من أبيه

ALUSI-FULL:v28p156/r7.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v28p156/r7.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v28p156/r7.claim: A hadith urges a man to call his household to prayer, fasting, almsgiving, and care for the poor, orphan, and neighbors, so God may gather them in Paradise.
ALUSI-FULL:v28p156/r7.anchor: وفي الحديث رحم الله رجلا قال : يا أهلاه صلاتكم صيامكم

ALUSI-FULL:v28p156/r8.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v28p156/r8.speaker: قيل
ALUSI-FULL:v28p156/r8.claim: It is also said that the most severely punished person on Judgment Day is one who neglected to teach his family.
ALUSI-FULL:v28p156/r8.anchor: وقيل : إن أشد الناس عذابا يوم القيامة من جهل أهله

ALUSI-FULL:v28p157/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v28p157/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v28p157/r1.claim: The first clause excludes rebellion and arrogance, paralleling 21:19; the second establishes competence and freedom from weariness, as in 21:19–20.
ALUSI-FULL:v28p157/r1.anchor: الجملة الأولى لنفي المعاندة والاستكبار عنهم صلوات الله تعالى عليهم فهي كقوله تعالى : ( لا يستكبرون عن عبادته ) والثانية لأثبات الكياسة لهم ونفي الكسل عنهم

ALUSI-FULL:v28p157/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v28p157/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v28p157/r2.claim: Non-disobedience describes inward acceptance and lack of refusal; doing what they are ordered describes prompt outward execution without slack, so the clauses are not redundant.
ALUSI-FULL:v28p157/r2.anchor: إن الأولى لبيان القبول باطنا فإن العصيان

ALUSI-FULL:v28p157/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v28p157/r3.speaker: المحصول
ALUSI-FULL:v28p157/r3.claim: Al-Mahsul explains the imperfect in لا يعصون as recounting past conduct, while يفعلون refers to what they will do in the future.
ALUSI-FULL:v28p157/r3.anchor: وفي المحصول ( لا يعصون ) فيما مضى على أن المضارع لحكاية الحال الماضية ( ويفعلون ما يؤمرون ) في الآتي

ALUSI-FULL:v28p157/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v28p157/r4.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v28p157/r4.claim: The two clauses may form an antimetabole, each restating the other’s meaning to stress that the angels show no pity in enforcing God’s commands and anger.
ALUSI-FULL:v28p157/r4.anchor: وجوز أن يكون ذلك من باب الطرد والعكس وهو كل كلامين يقرر الأول بمنطوقه مفهوم الثاني وبالعكس مبالغة في أنهم لا تأخذهم رأفة

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p169/r1.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p169/r1.speaker: عطاء عن ابن عباس
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p169/r1.claim: ʿAṭāʾ reports Ibn ʿAbbās's explanation: protect yourselves by refraining from what God forbids and doing what He commands.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p169/r1.anchor: قال عطاء عن ابن عباس: أي بالانتهاء عما نهاكم الله تعالى عنه

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p169/r2.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p169/r2.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p169/r2.claim: Protect your families by commanding good, forbidding evil, teaching, and disciplining them.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p169/r2.anchor: {وأهليكم نارا} يعني: مروهم بالخير وانهوهم عن الشر وعلموهم وأدبوهم تقوهم بذلك نارا

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p169/r3.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p169/r3.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p169/r3.claim: The angels stationed over the Fire are its keepers.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p169/r3.anchor: الحجارة عليها ملائكة} يعني خزنة النار

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p169/r4.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p169/r4.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p169/r4.claim: Ghilāẓ means harsh and coarse toward the people of Hell.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p169/r5.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p169/r5.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p169/r5.claim: Shidād means strong: one angel can push seventy thousand people into Hell with a single shove; they are the zabāniya, and God created no mercy in them.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p169/r5.anchor: {شداد} أقوياء يدفع الواحد منهم بالدفعة الواحدة سبعين ألفا في النار وهم الزبانية، لم يخلق الله فيهم الرحمة

BAYDAWI-FULL:66:6-7/r1.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:66:6-7/r1.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:66:6-7/r1.claim: Protect yourselves by avoiding sins and performing acts of obedience.

BAYDAWI-FULL:66:6-7/r2.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:66:6-7/r2.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:66:6-7/r2.claim: Protect your families through advice and instruction.

BAYDAWI-FULL:66:6-7/r3.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:66:6-7/r3.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:66:6-7/r3.claim: A reading has ahlūkum coordinated with the wāw of qū; anfusakum then refers to both groups by treating the addressed group as dominant.

BAYDAWI-FULL:66:6-7/r4.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:66:6-7/r4.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:66:6-7/r4.claim: People and stones fuel a Fire that blazes as other fires blaze when fed with wood.
BAYDAWI-FULL:66:6-7/r4.anchor: نارا تتقد بهما اتقاد غيرها بالحطب

BAYDAWI-FULL:66:6-7/r5.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:66:6-7/r5.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:66:6-7/r5.claim: The angels in charge of the Fire are the Zabāniya.

BAYDAWI-FULL:66:6-7/r6.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:66:6-7/r6.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:66:6-7/r6.claim: They are harsh in speech and strong in action, or harsh in nature and powerful enough for severe deeds.
BAYDAWI-FULL:66:6-7/r6.anchor: غلاظ الأقوال شداد الأفعال، أو غلاظ الخلق

BAYDAWI-FULL:66:6-7/r7.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:66:6-7/r7.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:66:6-7/r7.claim: The first clause may concern past conduct and the second future conduct; alternatively, the first means they accept commands without resistance and the second that they carry them out.
BAYDAWI-FULL:66:6-7/r7.anchor: فيما مضى. { ويفعلون ما يؤمرون } فيما يستقبل

BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r1.speaker: author
