BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r1.claim: The warning to the Prophet’s wives, left unnamed out of respect for him, leads to imitating his complete manners and the guardians who helped form theirs.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r1.anchor: ولما أبلغ سبحانه في عتاب أزواج النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم

BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r2.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r2.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r2.claim: The wives’ virtues arose from their guardians’ good upbringing, perfected by the Prophet’s good companionship and their adoption of his noble character.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r2.anchor: بحسن تأديب أوليائهن لهن وإكمال ذلك الأدب بحسن عشرته صلى الله عليه وسلم

BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r3.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r3.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r3.claim: The address generalizes the prior admonition: enjoin right and forbid wrong first among those nearest, securing God’s and spouses’ rights and household harmony.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r3.anchor: دالة على وجوب الأمر بالمعروف والنهي عن المنكر للأقرب فالأقرب

BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r4.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r4.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r4.claim: The address begins with the youngest, implying older Muslims have followed the example since entering Islam and need no new order.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r4.anchor: مخاطبة لأدنى الأسنان إشارة إلى أن من فوقهم تأسى من حين دخوله في الإسلام

BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r5.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r5.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r5.claim: Here those who believe are those who acknowledged the faith.

BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r6.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r6.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r6.claim: Protect yourselves by following the Prophet’s conduct toward Creator and creation, first observing proper manners with God and then with other people.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r6.anchor: أي اجعلوا لها وقاية بالتأسي به صلى الله عليه وسلم في أدبه

BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r7.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r7.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r7.claim: His example includes gentleness toward people who deserve gentleness, as an act of honoring the Creator.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r7.anchor: في لينه لمن يستحق اللين من الخلق تعظيما للخالق

BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r8.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r8.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r8.claim: A person is a shepherd responsible for the household, and family includes women, children, and everyone covered by that name.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r8.anchor: من النساء والأولاد وكل من يدخل في هذا الاسم قوهم

BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r9.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r9.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r9.claim: Guard family from the Fire through counsel and discipline so they acquire the character of the Prophet’s household.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r9.anchor: بالنصح والتأديب ليكونوا متخلقين بأخلاق أهل النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم

BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r10.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r10.speaker: سعيد بن العاص
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r10.claim: Saʿīd ibn al-ʿĀṣ transmits a Prophetic report that a father gives no gift to a child better than good manners; Aḥmad and al-Ṭabarānī are named, with no grading.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r10.anchor: كما روى أحمد والطبراني عن سعيد بن العاص رضي الله عنه رفعه

BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r11.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r11.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r11.claim: People and stones, the softest and hardest things, are named as fuel; anything between them is fuel all the more.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r11.anchor: { الناس والحجارة } أي ألين الأشياء وأصلبها

BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r12.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r12.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r12.claim: The angels’ being over Hell signifies their authority and control over it, enabled by God’s discipline of them.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r12.anchor: دلالة على تمكنهم من التصرف فيها

BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r13.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r13.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r13.claim: The angels are coarse in body and heart, stern toward those who deserve it because they disobeyed God.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r13.anchor: أي في الأبدان والقلوب فظاظة على أهلا لاستحقاقهم

BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r14.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r14.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r14.claim: They are strong in everything they undertake, in speech and action.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r14.anchor: أي في كل شيء يحاولونه بالقول والفعل حتى روي

BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r15.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r15.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r15.claim: An unattributed report says one angel casts seventy thousand unbelievers into the Fire in a single throw; no grading is given.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r15.anchor: حتى روي أن الواحد منهم يلقي بالدفعة الواحدة في النار

BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r16.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r16.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r16.claim: Their severity is applied to sinners according to the measure they deserve, as clarified by the declaration that they never disobey God.

BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r17.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r17.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r17.claim: They never disobey God at any time regarding whatever command He has given them.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r17.anchor: { لا يعصون الله } أي الملك الاعلى في وقت من الأوقات

BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r18.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r18.speaker: عبد الله بن عمرو وثوبات
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r18.claim: The Prophet said, as transmitted by Ibn Mājah from ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿAmr and by al-Ṭayālisī from Thawbān, Be upright, though you will not attain perfection; no grading is stated.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r18.anchor: فيما أخرجه ابن ماجة عن عبد الله بن عمرو رضي الله عنهما والطيالسي عن ثوبات

BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r19.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r19.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r19.claim: Unlike humans, who may omit a pillar, condition, or time through forgetfulness or sleep, or fail in recommended acts through whispers and inner talk, angels execute every command fully.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r19.anchor: ولما كان المطيع منا قد يخل ببعض المأمور به في ذاته

BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r20.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r20.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r20.claim: The imperfect verb portrays renewed, continuing performance with each command.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r20.anchor: أي مجددين مع كل أمر على سبيل الاستمرار

BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r21.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r21.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r21.claim: The passive construction hints at how easily they obey and leaves God as the obvious, understood commander.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p51/r21.anchor: لما لم يسم فاعله كناية عن سهولة انقايدهم

DURR-FULL:v8p224/r10.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p224/r10.speaker: علي بن أبي طالب
DURR-FULL:v8p224/r10.claim: Ali explains protecting oneself and one’s family from the Fire as teaching them good and disciplining them.
DURR-FULL:v8p224/r10.anchor: عن علي بن أبي طالب في قوله: {قوا أنفسكم وأهليكم نارا} قال: علموا أنفسكم وأهليكم الخير وأدبوهم

DURR-FULL:v8p224/r11.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p224/r11.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v8p224/r11.claim: Ibn Abbas says to know God’s obedience, avoid disobedience, and command one’s family to remember God so He saves them from the Fire.
DURR-FULL:v8p224/r11.anchor: عن ابن عباس في قوله: {قوا أنفسكم وأهليكم نارا} قال: اعلموا بطاعة الله واتقوا معاصي الله

DURR-FULL:v8p224/r12.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p224/r12.speaker: الضحاك
DURR-FULL:v8p224/r12.claim: Al-Dahhak says families should protect themselves as well.
DURR-FULL:v8p224/r12.anchor: عن الضحاك في قوله: {قوا أنفسكم وأهليكم نارا} قال: وأهليكم فليقوا أنفسهم

DURR-FULL:v8p224/r13.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p224/r13.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
DURR-FULL:v8p224/r13.claim: Zayd ibn Aslam says the Prophet answered that family protection means commanding what God loves and forbidding what He dislikes.
DURR-FULL:v8p224/r13.anchor: عن زيد بن أسلم قال: تلا رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم هذه الآية {قوا أنفسكم وأهليكم نارا} فقالوا: يا رسول الله

DURR-FULL:v8p225/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p225/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v8p225/r1.claim: Ibn Abbas explains protecting one’s family as disciplining them.
DURR-FULL:v8p225/r1.anchor: عن ابن عباس في قوله: {قوا أنفسكم وأهليكم نارا} قال: أدبوا أهليكم

DURR-FULL:v8p225/r2.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p225/r2.speaker: مجاهد
DURR-FULL:v8p225/r2.claim: Mujahid says to counsel one’s family to fear God.
DURR-FULL:v8p225/r2.anchor: عن مجاهد في قوله: {قوا أنفسكم وأهليكم نارا} قال: أوصوا أهليكم بتقوى الله

DURR-FULL:v8p225/r3.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p225/r3.speaker: قتادة
DURR-FULL:v8p225/r3.claim: Qatada says to command the family to obey God and forbid disobedience.
DURR-FULL:v8p225/r3.anchor: عن قتادة في قوله: {قوا أنفسكم وأهليكم نارا} قال: مروهم بطاعة الله وانهوهم عن معصية الله

DURR-FULL:v8p225/r4.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p225/r4.speaker: عيسى عليه السلام
DURR-FULL:v8p225/r4.claim: A report from Abd al-Aziz ibn Abi Rawwad says Jesus saw a suspended mountain fear it would fuel Hell; it asked him to pray for safety, God secured it, and it settled on earth.
DURR-FULL:v8p225/r4.anchor: عن عبد العزيز بن أبي رواد قال: مر عيسى عليه السلام بجبل معلق بين السماء والأرض فدخل فيه وبكى

DURR-FULL:v8p225/r5.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p225/r5.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
DURR-FULL:v8p225/r5.claim: Muhammad ibn Hashim says a young man collapsed as the Prophet recited this verse; the Prophet comforted him and said a stone from Hell would melt the world’s mountains and each person there has a stone or devil.
DURR-FULL:v8p225/r5.anchor: عن محمد بن هاشم قال: لما نزلت هذه الآية {وقودها الناس والحجارة} قرأها النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فسمعها شاب

DURR-FULL:v8p225/r6.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p225/r6.speaker: أبو عمران الجوني
DURR-FULL:v8p225/r6.claim: Abu Imran al-Jawni says Hell has nineteen keepers, each with a two-hundred-year shoulder span; they have no mercy, were created for punishment, and can pulverize a person with one blow.
DURR-FULL:v8p225/r6.anchor: عن أبي عمران الجوني قال: بلغنا أن خزنة النار تسعة عشر ما بين منكب أحدهم مسيرة مائتي خريف

DURR-FULL:v8p225/r7.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p225/r7.speaker: كعب
DURR-FULL:v8p225/r7.claim: Ka'b says each keeper has a two-pronged club and a shoulder span of a year’s journey; one push splits seven hundred thousand people.
DURR-FULL:v8p225/r7.anchor: عن كعب قال: ما بين منكب الخازن من خزنتها مسيرة ما بين سنة مع كل واحد منهم عمود وشعبتان

IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p364/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p364/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p364/r6.claim: The Prophet’s admonition of his wives appropriately prompts believers to admonish themselves and their families, even when advice causes some hurt rather than preserving affection at all costs.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p364/r6.anchor: كانت موعظة نساء النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم مناسبة لتنبيه المؤمنين لعدم الغفلة عن موعظة أنفسهم وموعظة أهليهم

IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p364/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p364/r7.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p364/r7.claim: This second address to believers follows completion of the first address to the Prophet, letting believers feel accompanied by him in admonishing their families.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p364/r7.anchor: وهذا نداء ثان موجه إلى المؤمنين بعد استيفاء المقصود من النداء الأول نداء النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم

IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p364/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p364/r8.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p364/r8.claim: Protecting oneself from the Fire represents admonition and warning either as their cause of avoiding punishment or as a forceful metaphor equating admonition with protection.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p364/r8.anchor: وعبر عن الموعظة والتحذير بالوقاية من النار على سبيل المجاز لأن الموعظة سبب في تجنب ما يفضي إلى عذاب النار

IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p364/r9.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p364/r9.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p364/r9.claim: The indefinite Fire is magnified; describing people and stones as its fuel intensifies warning, recalls the polytheists’ fate, and horrifies by making stones replace firewood.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p364/r9.anchor: وتنكير ( نار ) للتعظيم وأجرى عليها وصف بجملة { وقودها الناس والحجارة } زيادة في التحذير

IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p365/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p365/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p365/r1.claim: Muslims already knew that this Fire is fueled by people and stones from the earlier warning in 2:24 and the warning about what is worshipped besides God in 21:98.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p365/r1.anchor: ووصفت النار بهذه الجملة لأن مضمون هذه الجملة قد تقرر في علم المسلمين من قبل نزول هذه الآية

IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p365/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p365/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p365/r2.claim: حجارة is an irregular plural of حجر: the expected plural is أحجار, while حجار follows فعال and takes a feminine ending, like بكارة and مهارة.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p365/r2.anchor: والحجارة } : جمع الحجر على غير قياس فإن قياسه أحجار فجمعوه على حجار بوزن فعال

IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p365/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p365/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p365/r3.claim: The angels are assigned to the Fire; على metaphorically conveys their control and firm charge over it.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p365/r3.anchor: ومعنى { عليها } أنهم موكلون بها . فالاستعلاء المفاد من حرف ( على ) مستعار للتمكن

IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p365/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p365/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p365/r4.claim: غلاظ is the plural of غليظ, literally denoting roughness; here it metaphorically describes the angels’ harsh treatment of the people of Hell, as in the warning against a hard heart.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p365/r4.anchor: و { غلاظ } جمع غليظ وهو المتصف بالغلظة . وهي صفة مشبهة وفعلها مثل كرم . وهي هنا مستعارة لقساوة المعاملة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p365/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p365/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p365/r5.claim: شداد is the plural of شديد; the underlying شدة is force in harmful action, and here the angels are powerful in their treatment of Hell’s inhabitants.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p365/r5.anchor: و ( شداد ) : جمع شديد . والشدة بكسر الشين حقيقتها قوة العمل المؤذي والموصوف بها شديد . والمعنى : أنهم أقوياء في معاملة أهل النار

IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p365/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p365/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p365/r6.claim: Praising the angels’ obedience after calling them harsh balances the aversion those traits might provoke and implies that God ordered their severity in tormenting the people of Hell.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p365/r6.anchor: ثناء عليهم أعقب به وصفهم بأنهم غلاظ شداد تعديلا لما تقتضيانه من كراهية نفوس الناس إياهم

IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p365/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p365/r7.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p365/r7.claim: The clause praises the angels’ complete obedience and balances their severity; it also suggests their severity in punishing Hell’s inhabitants is itself commanded.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p365/r7.anchor: وهذا مؤذن بأنهم مأمورون بالغلظة والشدة في تعذيب أهل النار

IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p365/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p365/r8.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p365/r8.claim: Explicitly stating that they do what is commanded reiterates the preceding denial of disobedience, expands their praise, and vividly evokes their obedience; coordination treats the senses as distinct.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p365/r8.anchor: وأما قوله : { ويفعلون ما يؤمرون } فهو تصريح بمفهوم { لا يعصون الله ما أمرهم } دعا إليه مقام الإطناب

IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p365/r9.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p365/r9.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p365/r9.claim: A possible distinction is that لا يعصون concerns the angels’ own duties, while يفعلون ما يؤمرون concerns the work they are assigned on the sinners in Hell.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v28p365/r9.anchor: ولك أن تجعل مرجع { لا يعصون الله ما أمرهم } أنهم لا يعصون فيما يكلفون به من أعمالهم الخاصة بهم

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r1.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r1.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r1.claim: Protect yourselves and families by putting a safeguard between you and the Fire; protect family through counsel, correction, and praise for obedience.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r1.anchor: قوله تعالى: قوا أنفسكم وأهليكم معناه: اجعلوا وقاية بينكم وبين النار، وقد تقدم غير مرة تعليل اللفظة، وقوله تعالى: وأهليكم معناه: بالوصية لهم والتقويم والحمد على طاعة الله

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r2.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r2.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r2.claim: A hadith warns, “Do not commit adultery, or your family will commit adultery.”

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r3.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r3.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r3.claim: A report asks God to have mercy on a man who calls his family to prayer, fasting, care for the poor, and care for orphans.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r3.anchor: وفي حديث آخر: «رحم الله رجلا قال: يا أهلاه، صلاتكم، صيامكم، مسكينكم، يتيمكم»

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r4.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r4.speaker: جمهور
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r4.claim: The majority read وقودها with fatḥa on wāw.

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r5.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r5.speaker: مجاهد والحسن وطلحة وعيسى والفياض بن غزوان وأبو حيوة
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r5.claim: Mujāhid, al-Ḥasan, Ṭalḥa, ʿĪsā, al-Fayyāḍ ibn Ghazwān, and Abū Ḥaywa read it with ḍamma.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r5.anchor: وقرأ مجاهد والحسن وطلحة وعيسى والفياض بن غزوان وأبو حيوة بضمها

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r6.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r6.speaker: بعضهم
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r6.claim: One view treats the readings as synonymous; another makes ḍamma a verbal noun and fatḥa a noun.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r6.anchor: وقيل هما بمعنى، وقيل الضم مصدر والفتح اسم

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r7.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r7.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r7.claim: A report identifies the stones as sulfur; the discussion appeared earlier in al-Baqara.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r7.anchor: ويروى أن الحجارة: هي حجارة الكبريت، وقد تقدم القول في ذلك في سورة البقرة

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r8.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r8.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r8.claim: Another report says the stones are all kinds of stone.

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r9.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r9.speaker: عيسى ابن مريم
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r9.claim: Jesus follows a moan to a weeping stone that fears becoming fuel for the Fire; Jesus marvels and leaves.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r9.anchor: وفي بعض الحديث أن عيسى ابن مريم سمع أنينا في فلاة من الأرض فتبعه حتى بلغ إلى حجر يئن ويحزن، فقال له: ما بالك أيها الحجر

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r10.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r10.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r10.claim: The story may come from the Torah or Gospel; the stone's speech rendered in Arabic used this wording.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r10.anchor: ويشبه أن يكون هذا المعنى في التوراة أو في الإنجيل، فذلك الذي سمع الحجر إذا عبر عنه بالعربية كان هذا اللفظ

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r11.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r11.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r11.claim: The angels' severity means hardness of heart, forceful grasp, and roughness, as in 3:159.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r11.anchor: ووصف الملائكة بالغلظة معناه في القلوب والبطش الشديد والفظاظة، كما قال تعالى لنبيه: ولو كنت فظا غليظ القلب لانفضوا من حولك

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r12.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r12.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r12.anchor: والشدة القوة، وقيل المراد شدتهم على الكفار

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r13.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r13.speaker: بعضهم
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r13.claim: Some say شِداد describes severity toward unbelievers, synonymous with غلاظ.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r13.anchor: وقيل المراد شدتهم على الكفار، فهي بمعنى الغلظ

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r14.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r14.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r14.claim: The angels' obedience is stated and then repeated for emphasis.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r14.anchor: ووصفهم تعالى بالطواعية لربهم، وكرر المعنى تأكيدا بقوله تعالى: ويفعلون ما يؤمرون

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r15.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r15.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r15.claim: This implies angels execute unbelievers' entry into the Fire willingly and forcefully, explaining the command not to make excuses.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p333/r15.anchor: وفي قوله تعالى: ويفعلون ما يؤمرون ما يقتضي أنهم يدخلون الكفار النار بجد واختيار، ويغلظون عليهم

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p312#2/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p312#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p312#2/r1.claim: Protecting oneself from the Fire means obeying the commands and avoiding prohibitions.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p312#2/r1.anchor: وقاية النفس بامتثال الأوامر واجتاب النواهي

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p312#2/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p312#2/r2.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p312#2/r2.claim: Protecting one’s family means commanding them to obey and forbidding them to sin.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p312#2/r2.anchor: ووقاية الأهل بأن يؤمروا بالطاعة وينهوا عن المعصية

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p312#2/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p312#2/r3.speaker: علي
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p312#2/r3.claim: ʿAlī says to teach and discipline the family.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p312#2/r3.anchor: قال علي رضي الله عنه علموهم وأدبوهم

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p312#2/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p312#2/r4.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p312#2/r4.claim: The commentary refers readers to its earlier explanation of the Fire’s human and stone fuel at 2:24.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p312#2/r4.anchor: وقودها الناس والحجارة وقد ذكرناه في البقرة 24

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p312#2/r5.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p312#2/r5.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p312#2/r5.claim: One explanation says the angels are severe toward the inhabitants of Hell and strong against them; another says their hearts are harsh and their bodies strong.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p312#2/r5.anchor: على أهل النار شداد عليهم وقيل غلاظ القلوب شداد الأبدان

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p312#2/r6.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p312#2/r6.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p312#2/r6.claim: Abū Ṣāliḥ reports from Ibn ʿAbbās that Hell has nineteen keepers; each has a shoulder-span of a year’s journey and strength to strike seventy thousand into Hell’s depths with one mace-blow.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p312#2/r6.anchor: وروى أبو صالح عن ابن عباس قال خزنة النار تسعة عشر ما بين منكبي أحدهم مسيرة سنة

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p312#2/r7.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p312#2/r7.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p312#2/r7.claim: One explanation says the angels do not exceed what they are commanded.

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p312#2/r8.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p312#2/r8.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p312#2/r8.claim: A second explanation says they carry out commands at their appointed time, neither delaying nor advancing them.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p312#2/r8.anchor: يفعلونه في وقته لا يؤخرونه ولا يقدمونه

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167/r1.speaker: علي
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167/r1.claim: Ali glosses protecting yourselves and your families from the Fire as disciplining and teaching them.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167/r1.anchor: عن علي، رضي الله عنه، في قوله تعالى: {قوا أنفسكم وأهليكم نارا} يقول: أدبوهم، علموهم.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167/r2.claim: Ibn Abbas says to obey God, avoid disobedience, and command one's family to remember God, by which God saves them from the Fire.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167/r2.anchor: عن ابن عباس: {قوا أنفسكم وأهليكم نارا} يقول: اعملوا بطاعة الله، واتقوا معاصي الله،

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167/r3.speaker: مجاهد
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167/r3.claim: Mujahid explains the command as fearing God and advising one's family to fear God.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167/r3.anchor: وقال مجاهد: {قوا أنفسكم وأهليكم نارا} قال: اتقوا الله، وأوصوا أهليكم بتقوى الله.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167/r4.speaker: قتادة
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167/r4.claim: Qatada says to command obedience, forbid disobedience, uphold God's commands, assist the family in them, and restrain and rebuke them when they sin.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167/r4.anchor: وقال قتادة: يأمرهم بطاعة الله، وينهاهم عن معصية الله، وأن يقوم عليهم بأمر الله،

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167/r5.speaker: الضحاك ومقاتل
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167/r5.claim: Al-Dahhak and Muqatil say a Muslim must teach family members, including relatives and enslaved people, the duties God imposed and the acts He prohibited.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167/r5.anchor: وهكذا قال الضحاك ومقاتل: حق على المسلم أن يعلم أهله، من قرابته وإمائه وعبيده،

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167/r6.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167/r6.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167/r6.claim: A prophetic report commands teaching children prayer at seven and striking them for neglecting it at ten; al-Tirmidhi grades this wording hasan.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167/r6.anchor: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: "مروا الصبي بالصلاة إذا بلغ سبع سنين، فإذا بلغ

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167/r7.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167/r7.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167/r7.claim: Abu Dawud also transmits through Amr ibn Shuayb, from his father and grandfather, a prophetic report giving the same instruction about children's prayer.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167/r7.anchor: من حديث عمرو بن شعيب، عن أبيه، عن جده عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم مثل ذلك

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167/r8.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167/r8.speaker: الفقهاء
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167/r8.claim: Jurists extend the training principle to fasting so children reach maturity accustomed to worship, obedience, avoiding sin, and leaving wrongdoing.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167/r8.anchor: قال الفقهاء: وهكذا في الصوم؛ ليكون ذلك تمرينا له على العبادة، لكي يبلغ وهو مستمر

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167#2/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167#2/r1.claim: The fuel is the firewood cast into the Fire: the bodies of human beings.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167#2/r1.anchor: {وقودها} أي: حطبها الذي يلقى فيها جثث بني آدم.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167#2/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167#2/r2.speaker: قيل
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167#2/r2.claim: One view identifies the stones as the idols people worshipped, citing the statement that worshippers and what they worship besides God are fuel for Hell.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167#2/r2.anchor: {والحجارة} قيل: المراد بذلك الأصنام التي كانت تعبد لقوله:

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167#2/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167#2/r3.speaker: ابن مسعود ومجاهد وأبو جعفر الباقر والسدي
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167#2/r3.claim: Ibn Masud, Mujahid, Abu Jafar al-Baqir, and al-Suddi identify the stones as sulfur stones.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167#2/r3.anchor: وقال ابن مسعود ومجاهد وأبو جعفر الباقر، والسدي: هي حجارة من كبريت

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167#2/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167#2/r4.speaker: مجاهد
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167#2/r4.claim: Mujahid adds that the sulfur stones smell worse than carrion.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167#2/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167#2/r5.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167#2/r5.claim: In a report Ibn Abi Hatim calls mursal and gharīb, an elderly companion asks whether Hell's stones resemble earthly stones; the Prophet swears one rock of Hell is greater than all the world's mountains. The man faints, revives, professes God's oneness, and is promised Paradise; the Prophet confirms this and cites God's warning.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p167#2/r5.anchor: فقال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم: "والذي نفسي بيده، لصخرة من صخر جهنم أعظم من جبال الدنيا كلها".

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p168/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p168/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p168/r1.claim: The keepers have harsh natures because mercy toward those who disbelieve in God has been removed from their hearts.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p168/r1.anchor: أي: طباعهم غليظة، قد نزعت من قلوبهم الرحمة بالكافرين بالله،

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p168/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p168/r2.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p168/r2.claim: Their constitution is extremely strong and dense, and their appearance is frightening.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p168/r2.anchor: أي: تركيبهم في غاية الشدة والكثافة والمنظر المزعج.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p168/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p168/r3.speaker: عكرمة
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p168/r3.claim: Ikrima describes 400,000 dark-faced, merciless keepers at Hell's first gate, followed by nineteen keepers of immense size; the gates are separated by five hundred years of descent, and each later gate has keepers like those at the first.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p168/r3.anchor: عن عكرمة أنه قال: إذا وصل أول أهل النار إلى النار، وجدوا على الباب أربعمائة ألف من خزنة جهنم،

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p168#2/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p168#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p168#2/r1.claim: The angels promptly carry out every divine command without even a moment's delay and are fully able to do it.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p168#2/r1.anchor: أي: مهما أمرهم به تعالى يبادروا إليه،

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p168#2/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p168#2/r2.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p168#2/r2.claim: These angels are the Zabaniya, the keepers of Hell from whom refuge is sought.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p168#2/r2.anchor: وهؤلاء هم الزبانية عياذا بالله منهم.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27/r1.speaker: أبو النصر إسماعيل بن حماد الجوهري
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27/r1.claim: Al-Jawhari defines ʿasab as palm frond material above the crown that has not grown leaflets; leaf-bearing material is called saʿaf.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27/r1.anchor: قال أبو النصر إسماعيل بن حماد الجوهري: وهو من السعف فويق الكرب

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27/r2.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27/r2.claim: Likhaf are thin, flat pieces of stone on which the companions wrote Quran, alongside palm stems and other available materials.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27/r2.anchor: واللخاف: جمع لخفة وهي القطعة من الحجارة مستدقة

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27/r3.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27/r3.claim: Zayd ibn Thabit gathered Quran from written palm stems, stone pieces, and memorization, because the companions carefully safeguarded the trust entrusted by the Prophet.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27/r3.anchor: فتلقاه زيد بن ثابت من هذا من عسيبه، ومن هذا من لخافه، ومن صدر هذا، أي من حفظه

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27/r4.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27/r4.claim: Ibn Kathir connects the companions' trust in conveying revelation to God's command that the Messenger deliver what was sent down to him.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27/r4.anchor: ياأيها الرسول بلغ ما أنزل إليك من ربك

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27/r5.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27/r5.claim: At the Farewell Pilgrimage on Arafat, the Prophet asked the assembled companions to testify that he had conveyed, fulfilled, and advised; he called God as witness. Muslim reports it from Jabir.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27/r5.anchor: إنكم مسؤولون عني فما أنتم قائلون

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27/r6.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27/r6.speaker: رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27/r6.claim: The Prophet instructed those present to convey to those absent and to transmit even a single verse.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27/r6.anchor: وقد أمر أمته أن يبلغ الشاهد الغائب وقال: "بلغوا عني ولو آية"

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27/r7.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27/r7.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27/r7.claim: The companions transmitted Quran and Sunnah separately; the order to erase other written material was meant to prevent its confusion with Quran, not to forbid memorizing or narrating Sunnah.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27/r7.anchor: ولهذا قال عليه الصلاة والسلام: "من كتب عني سوى القرآن فليمحه"

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27/r8.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27/r8.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27/r8.claim: Ibn Kathir says it is certain that all Quran delivered by the Prophet reached later generations without loss.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27/r8.anchor: فلهذا نعلم بالضرورة أنه لم يبق من القرآن مما أداه الرسول صلى الله عليه وسلم إليهم إلا وقد بلغوه إلينا

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27/r9.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27/r9.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27/r9.claim: Collecting the Quran in written sheets was a major religious benefit: Abu Bakr safeguarded the sheets, Umar inherited them, Hafsa held them after Umar's death, and Uthman later took them.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v1p27/r9.anchor: فكان الذي فعله الشيخان أبو بكر وعمر، رضي الله عنهما، من أكبر المصالح الدينية وأعظمها، من حفظهما كتاب الله في الصحف

JISHUMI:v10p6992/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p6992/r1.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p6992/r1.claim: Wiqāya means guarding and preserving; command forms are singular قِ, dual قِيا, and plural قُوا, paralleling الوفاء.
JISHUMI:v10p6992/r1.anchor: الوقاية: الحراسة والحفظ، وقى يقي وقاية فهو واق، والأمر للواحد: ق يا هذا، وللاثنين: قيا، وللجماعة: قوا

JISHUMI:v1p602/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v1p602/r1.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v1p602/r1.claim: Prophets' concern for their children is confined to religion; believers likewise should care for their families' religious welfare.
JISHUMI:v1p602/r1.anchor: وتدل على أن شفقة الأنبياء على أولادهم تكون في باب الدين فقط، وكذلك ينبغي للمؤمن

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r1.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r1.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r1.claim: Guard yourselves by avoiding sins and performing acts of obedience.

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r2.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r2.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r2.claim: Guard your families by requiring of them what you require of yourselves.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r2.anchor: بأن تأخذوهم بما تأخذون به أنفسكم

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r3.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r3.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r3.claim: A hadith urges a man to call his family to prayer, fasting, alms, and care for the poor, orphans, and neighbors, hoping they will join him in Paradise.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r3.anchor: ( 1212 ) ( رحم الله رجلا قال يا أهلاه صلاتكم صيامكم زكاتكم

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r4.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r4.speaker: قيل
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r4.claim: It is said that the person most severely punished on the Resurrection Day is one who was ignorant of his family.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r4.anchor: وقيل : إن أشد الناس عذابا يوم القيامة من جهل أهله

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r5.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r5.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r5.claim: A reading has وأهلوكم, coordinated with the subject pronoun in قوا; the intervening material makes the coordination acceptable.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r5.anchor: وقرىء : ( وأهلوكم ) ، عطفا على واو { قوا } وحسن العطف للفاصل

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r6.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r6.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r6.claim: The coordination is not elliptical for telling families to guard themselves: the families are estimated alongside the addressed subject, yielding ‘you and your families guard yourselves.’
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r6.anchor: ولكن المعطوف مقارن في التقدير للواو ، وأنفسكم واقع بعده

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r7.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r7.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r7.claim: This is a kind of fire ignited only by people and stones, unlike ordinary fires ignited by firewood.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r7.anchor: نوعا من النار لا يتقد إلا بالناس والحجارة ، كما يتقد غيرها من النيران بالحطب

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r8.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r8.speaker: ابن عباس
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r8.claim: Ibn Abbas identifies the stones as sulfur, which becomes exceptionally hot when kindled.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r8.anchor: وعن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما : هي حجارة الكبريت ، وهي أشد الأشياء حرا

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r9.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r9.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r9.claim: A reading with ḍamma on the wāw means that the fire has fuel.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r9.anchor: وقرىء : ( وقودها ) بالضم ، أي ذو وقودها

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r10.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r10.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r10.claim: The angels guarding the fire are the nineteen zabāniya and their assistants.

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r11.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r11.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r11.claim: The angels are massive and strong in body, or harsh and rough in action; they show no pity in executing God's commands and avenging His enemies.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r11.anchor: في أجرامهم غلظة وشدة ، أي : جفاء وقوة . أو في أفعالهم جفاء وخشونة

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r12.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r12.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r12.claim: ما أمرهم is accusative as an appositive, meaning they do not disobey what God commanded; it can also mean they do not disobey Him in what He commands.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r12.anchor: في محل النصب على البدل ، أي : لا يعصون ما أمر الله

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r13.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r13.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r13.claim: The first clause says the angels accept and commit to God's orders without refusal; the second says they execute them without reluctance or delay.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r13.anchor: فإن معنى الأولى أنهم يتقبلون أوامره ويلتزمونها ولا يأبونها ولا ينكرونها

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r14.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r14.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r14.claim: Although the fire is prepared for disbelievers, believers are warned because sinful believers occupy the same abode as them, even if their levels are higher.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r14.anchor: الفساق وإن كانت دركاتهم فوق دركات الكفار ، فإنهم مساكنون الكفار في دار واحدة

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r15.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r15.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r15.claim: Alternatively, the command warns believers to protect themselves from apostasy and regretting their entry into Islam.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r15.anchor: ويجوز أن يأمرهم بالتوقي من الارتداد ، والندم على الدخول في الإسلام

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r16.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r16.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r16.claim: Alternatively, the address is to people who professed faith only with their tongues, namely hypocrites; the following address to disbelievers supports this reading.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p572/r16.anchor: وأن يكون خطابا للذين آمنوا بألسنتهم وهم المنافقون ؛ ويعضد ذلك قوله تعالى

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p43/r1.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p43/r1.speaker: خيثمة
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p43/r1.claim: Khaythama says every address to believers in the Quran corresponds in the Torah to an address to the poor.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p43/r1.anchor: قال خيثمة : كل شيء في القرآن يا أيها الذين آمنوا ففي التوراة يا أيها المساكين .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p43/r2.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p43/r2.speaker: ابن مسعود
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p43/r2.claim: Ibn Masud says to heed such an address: it brings either a command to do good or a prohibition of evil.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p43/r2.anchor: وقال ابن مسعود : إذا قال الله يا أيها الذين آمنوا فارعها سمعك فإنه خير تؤمر به أو شر تنهى عنه .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p43/r3.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p43/r3.speaker: الزهري
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p43/r3.claim: Al-Zuhri says that when God commands the believers to act, the Prophet is among them.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p43/r3.anchor: وقال الزهري : إذا قال الله تعالى : يا أيها الذين آمنوا افعلوا , فالنبي منهم .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p43/r4.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p43/r4.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p43/r4.claim: The command means to keep yourselves away from the Fire; a rajaz line uses the same root for protection.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p43/r4.anchor: ومعنى قوله : { قوا أنفسكم وأهليكم نارا } أي اصرفوا عنها النار , ومنه قول الراجز : ولو توقى لوقاه الواقي

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r1.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r1.speaker: الضحاك
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r1.claim: One reading of the command is: protect yourselves, and let your families protect themselves from the Fire.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r1.anchor: أحدها : معناه قوا أنفسكم , وأهلوكم فليقوا أنفسهم نارا , قاله الضحاك .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r2.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r2.claim: Protect yourselves and instruct your families in remembrance and prayer so God may protect you through them; Ibn Abbas reports this through Ibn Abi Talha.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r2.anchor: الثاني : قوا أنفسكم ومروا أهليكم بالذكر والدعاء حتى يقيكم الله بهم , رواه ابن أبي طلحة عن ابن عباس .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r3.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r3.speaker: علي وقتادة ومجاهد
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r3.claim: Protect yourselves through your deeds and your families through your counsel.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r3.anchor: الثالث : قوا أنفسكم بأفعالكم , وقوا أهليكم بوصيتكم , قاله علي وقتادة ومجاهد .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r4.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r4.speaker: قتادة
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r4.claim: Counsel that protects a family means commanding obedience to God and forbidding disobedience.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r4.anchor: أحدها : يأمرهم بطاعة الله وينهاهم عن معصيته , قاله قتادة .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r5.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r5.speaker: علي
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r5.claim: Counsel means teaching family members their duties and disciplining them in worldly affairs.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r5.anchor: الثاني : يعلمهم فروضهم ويؤدبهم في دنياهم , قاله علي .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r6.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r6.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r6.claim: Counsel also means teaching and enjoining good, explaining evil, and forbidding it.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r6.anchor: الثالث : يعلمهم الخير ويأمرهم به , ويبين لهم الشر , وينهاهم عنه .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r7.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r7.speaker: مقاتل
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r7.claim: The duty applies to oneself, one's children, and one's male and female slaves.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r7.anchor: قال مقاتل : حق ذلك عليه في نفسه وولده وعبيده وإمائه .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r8.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r8.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r8.claim: The stones may be the idols they worshipped, so they witness what brought them to the Fire; 21:98 makes this explicit.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r8.anchor: أحدها : أنها الحجارة التي عبدوها , حتى يشاهدوا ما أوجب مصيرهم إلى النار ,

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r9.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r9.speaker: ابن مسعود ومجاهد
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r9.claim: The stones are sulfurous stones that intensify the Fire's fuel, adding to the threat and punishment.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r9.anchor: الثاني : أنها حجارة من كبريت وهي تزيد في وقودها النار وكان ذكرها زيادة في الوعيد والعذاب , قاله ابن مسعود ومجاهد .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r10.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r10.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r10.claim: Mentioning stones shows that a fire able to burn stones can burn people even more intensely.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r10.anchor: الثالث : أنه ذكر الحجارة ليعلموا أن ما أحرق الحجارة فهو أبلغ في إحراق الناس .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r11.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r11.speaker: رسول الله
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r11.claim: Ibn Abi Zaidah reports that the Prophet said a stone in Hell is larger than all the world's mountains; an old man fainted, professed faith when revived, and was promised Paradise, with 14:14 cited in response to the companions.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r11.anchor: روى ابن أبي زائدة قال : بلغني أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم تلا هذه الآية

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r12.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r12.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r12.claim: The keepers are the Zabaniya, harsh in heart and forceful in action.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r12.anchor: يعني غلاظ القلوب , شداد الأفعال وهم الزبانية .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r13.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r13.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r13.claim: The angels do not disobey by adding anything to or omitting anything from God's command.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r13.anchor: أي لا يخالفونه في أمره من زيادة أو نقصان .

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r14.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r14.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r14.claim: They carry out what they are commanded at its appointed time, neither early nor late.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p44/r14.anchor: يعني في وقته فلا يؤخرونه ولا يقدمونه .

MUJAHID:v2p683#2/r1.author: Mujāhid b. Jabr
MUJAHID:v2p683#2/r1.speaker: مجاهد
MUJAHID:v2p683#2/r1.claim: Mujahid explains protecting oneself and one's family from the Fire as fearing God, advising one's family to fear Him, and disciplining them.
MUJAHID:v2p683#2/r1.anchor: عن ابن أبي نجيح عن مجاهد ﴿ قوا أنفسكم وأهليكم نارا ﴾ قال يقول اتقوا الله عز وجل وأوصوا أهليكم بتقوى الله وأدبوهم

MUQATIL:66:6/r1.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:66:6/r1.speaker: author
MUQATIL:66:6/r1.claim: Believers protect themselves and their families from the afterlife Fire through proper conduct and discipline.
MUQATIL:66:6/r1.anchor: { يأيها الذين آمنوا قوا أنفسكم وأهليكم } بالأدب الصالح النار في الآخرة

MUQATIL:66:6/r2.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:66:6/r2.speaker: author
MUQATIL:66:6/r2.claim: People are the Fire's inhabitants; sulfur-like stones are attached to disbelievers' necks and kindle the flames against their faces.
MUQATIL:66:6/r2.anchor: { نارا وقودها الناس } يعني أهلها { والحجارة } تتعلق في عنق الكافر مثل جبل الكبريت

MUQATIL:66:6/r3.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:66:6/r3.speaker: author
MUQATIL:66:6/r3.claim: The angels are the nineteen keepers of Hell, stern and powerful; one has shoulder-span of a year's journey and a mace blow scatters seventy thousand bones, sending a person down for forty years, neither alive nor dead.
MUQATIL:66:6/r3.anchor: { عليها } يعني على النار { ملائكة } يعني خزنتها التسعة عشر { غلاظ شداد } يعني أقوياء

MUQATIL:66:6/r4.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:66:6/r4.speaker: author
MUQATIL:66:6/r4.claim: Those who do not disobey and do what they are commanded are the keepers of Hell.
MUQATIL:66:6/r4.anchor: { لا يعصون الله مآ أمرهم ويفعلون ما يؤمرون } [آية: 6] يعني خزنة جهنم

MUQATIL:74:31/r3.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:74:31/r3.speaker: author
MUQATIL:74:31/r3.claim: The description of angels as stern and mighty answers Abu al-Ashdayn's boast that he could defeat seventeen guardians.
MUQATIL:74:31/r3.anchor:
وأنزل الله في قول أبي الأشدين: أنا أكفيكم منهم سبعة عشر:
عليها ملائكة غلاظ شداد
[التحريم: 6]

NASAFI-FULL:v4p260#2/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p260#2/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p260#2/r1.claim: Protect yourselves by leaving sins and performing acts of obedience.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p260#2/r1.anchor: بترك المعاصي وفعل الطاعات ﴿ وأهليكم ﴾ بان تأخذوهم

NASAFI-FULL:v4p260#2/r2.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p260#2/r2.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p260#2/r2.claim: Require your families to do what you require of yourselves.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p260#2/r2.anchor: بان تأخذوهم بما تأخذون به أنفسكم

NASAFI-FULL:v4p260#2/r3.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p260#2/r3.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p260#2/r3.claim: This kind of fire is fueled only by people and stones, unlike other fires fueled by wood.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p260#2/r3.anchor: نوعا من النار لا تتقد إلا بالناس والحجارة كما يتقد غيرها من النيران بالحطب

NASAFI-FULL:v4p260#2/r4.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p260#2/r4.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p260#2/r4.claim: The phrase refers to the administration of the Fire and the tormenting of its inhabitants.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p260#2/r4.anchor: بلى أمرها وتعذيب أهلها ﴿ ملائكة ﴾ يعني الزبانية

NASAFI-FULL:v4p260#2/r5.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p260#2/r5.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p260#2/r5.claim: The keepers are the nineteen tormenting angels and their assistants.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p260#2/r5.anchor: يعني الزبانية التسعة عشر واعوانهم ﴿ غلاظ شداد ﴾

NASAFI-FULL:v4p260#2/r6.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p260#2/r6.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p260#2/r6.claim: Their bodies may be coarse and strong, or their speech coarse and their actions strong.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p260#2/r6.anchor: في اجرامهم غلظة وشدة أو غلاظ الأقوال شداد الأفعال

NASAFI-FULL:v4p260#2/r7.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p260#2/r7.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p260#2/r7.claim: “لا يعصون الله” is a nominative adjective clause; “ما أمرهم” is accusative as a substitute, or means they do not disobey what God commands.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p260#2/r7.anchor: في موضع الرفع على النعت ﴿ ما أمرهم ﴾ في محل النصب على البدل

NASAFI-FULL:v4p260#2/r8.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p260#2/r8.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p260#2/r8.claim: The first clause means they accept and adhere to God's commands; the second says they carry them out without delay or sluggishness.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p260#2/r8.anchor: إذ معنى الأولى انهم يتقبلون أوامره ويلتزمونها ومعنى الثانية أنهم يؤدون ما يؤمرون به

QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r1.claim: The verse commands a person to protect himself and his family from the Fire.
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r1.anchor: فيه مسألة واحدة وهي الأمر بوقاية الإنسان نفسه وأهله النار

QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r2.speaker: الضحاك
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r2.claim: Al-Ḍaḥḥāk reads the command as protecting yourselves and having your families protect themselves.
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r2.anchor: قال الضحاك: معناه قوا أنفسكم، وأهلوكم فليقوا أنفسهم نارا.

QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r3.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās, through ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭalḥa, says to protect yourselves and command your families to remember God and pray so He protects them through you.
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r3.anchor: وروى علي بن أبي طلحة عن ابن عباس: قوا أنفسكم وأمروا أهليكم بالذكر والدعاء

QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r4.speaker: علي وقتادة ومجاهد
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r4.claim: ʿAlī, Qatāda, and Mujāhid say people protect themselves through their own deeds and their families through admonition.
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r4.anchor: وقال علي رضي الله عنه وقتادة ومجاهد: قوا أنفسكم بأفعالكم وقوا أهليكم بوصيتكم.

QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r5.speaker: ابن العربي
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r5.claim: Ibn al-ʿArabī calls the preceding view correct: the conjunction makes both objects share the command, so one must obey and reform the family as a shepherd guides a flock.
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r5.anchor: ابن العربي: وهو الصحيح، والفقه الذي يعطيه العطف الذي يقتضي التشريك بين المعطوف والمعطوف عليه

QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r6.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r6.claim: The coordinated objects share the action, as in Arabic examples pairing feeding hay with cold water or seeing a spouse carrying a sword and spear.
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r6.anchor:
والفقه الذي يعطيه العطف الذي يقتضي التشريك بين المعطوف والمعطوف عليه في معنى الفعل كقوله:
علفتها تبنا وماء باردا

QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r7.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r7.claim: A man must correct himself through obedience and reform his family as a shepherd tends his flock.
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r7.anchor: فعلى الرجل أن يصلح نفسه بالطاعة، ويصلح أهله إصلاح الراعي للرعية.

QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r8.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r8.claim: A sound hadith says everyone is a shepherd responsible for those in their care, including a man responsible for his household.
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r8.anchor:
ففي صحيح الحديث: أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال:
" كلكم راع وكلكم مسؤول عن رعيته

QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r9.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r9.speaker: الحسن
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r9.claim: Al-Ḥasan paraphrases the duty as commanding family members and forbidding them.
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r9.anchor: وعن هذا عبر الحسن في هذه الآية [بقوله:] يأمرهم وينهاهم.

QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r10.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r10.speaker: بعض العلماء
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r10.claim: Some scholars say children are included within a person's self because a child is part of the parent, as in 24:61; they must be taught lawful and unlawful matters and kept from sins.
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r10.anchor: وقال بعض العلماء لما قال: { قوا أنفسكم } دخل فيه الأولاد لأن الولد بعض منه.

QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r11.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r11.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r11.claim: A report says a child's right over the parent is to receive a good name, be taught writing, and be married when reaching maturity.
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r11.anchor:
وقال عليه السلام:
" حق الولد على الوالد أن يحسن اسمه ويعلمه الكتابة

QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r12.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r12.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r12.claim: A report says no parent gives a child a better gift than good upbringing.
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r12.anchor: نحل والد ولدا أفضل من أدب حسن

QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r13.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r13.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r13.claim: Through ʿAmr ibn Shuʿayb, his father, and grandfather, the Prophet instructs parents to order prayer at seven, discipline for it at ten, and separate children's beds; hadith scholars transmitted it, with this wording in Abū Dāwūd.
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r13.anchor:
وقد روى عمرو بن شعيب عن أبيه عن جده: عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
" مروا أبناءكم بالصلاة لسبع

QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r14.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r14.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r14.claim: A separate report from Samura ibn Jundub says to command a child to pray at seven and discipline him for it at ten; Abū Dāwūd also transmits it.
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6/r14.anchor:
وخرج أيضا عن سمرة بن جندب قال: قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم:
" مروا الصبي بالصلاة إذا بلغ سبع سنين

QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#2/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#2/r1.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#2/r1.claim: Muslim transmits that the Prophet, when praying witr, told ʿĀʾisha to get up and pray witr too.
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#2/r1.anchor: أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم كان إذا أوتر يقول:«قومي فأوتري يا عائشة»

QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#2/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#2/r2.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#2/r2.claim: The Prophet asks God's mercy for a man or woman who rises for night prayer and wakes their spouse, sprinkling water on the spouse's face if needed.
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#2/r2.anchor:
وروي: أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال:
" رحم الله امرءا قام من الليل فصلى فأيقظ أهله

QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#2/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#2/r3.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#2/r3.claim: The Prophet also urges people to wake the women of the household chambers.
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#2/r3.anchor:
ومنه قوله صلى الله عليه وسلم:
" أيقظوا صواحب الحجر

QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#2/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#2/r4.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#2/r4.claim: These duties fall under the command to cooperate in righteousness and piety in 5:2.
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#2/r4.anchor:
ويدخل هذا في عموم قوله تعالى:
وتعاونوا على البر والتقوى

QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#2/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#2/r5.speaker: عمر
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#2/r5.claim: Al-Qushayrī reports that ʿUmar asked how to protect one's family; the Prophet answered by forbidding what God forbade and commanding what He commanded.
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#2/r5.anchor:
وذكر القشيري:
" أن عمر رضي الله عنه قال لما نزلت هذه الآية: يا رسول الله، نقي أنفسنا

QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#2/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#2/r6.speaker: مقاتل
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#2/r6.claim: Muqātil says this duty applies to oneself, children, family, male servants, and female servants.
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#2/r6.anchor: وقال مقاتل: ذلك حق عليه في نفسه وولده وأهله وعبيده وإمائه.

QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#2/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#2/r7.speaker: الكيا
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#2/r7.claim: Al-Kiyā says parents must teach children and family religion, goodness, and necessary manners, connecting this to 20:132 and 26:214.
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#2/r7.anchor: قال الكيا: فعلينا تعليم أولادنا وأهلينا الدين والخير، وما لا يستغنى عنه من الأدب.

QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#2/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#2/r8.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#2/r8.claim: The verse's family instruction is connected to God's command to the Prophet to order his family to prayer in 20:132 and warn his nearest kin in 26:214.
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#2/r8.anchor:
وهو قوله تعالى:
وأمر أهلك بالصلاة واصطبر عليها
[طه:132]. ونحو قوله تعالى للنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم:
وأنذر عشيرتك الأقربين

QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#2/r9.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#2/r9.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#2/r9.claim: The Prophet's instruction to command children to pray at seven is cited again.
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#2/r9.anchor:
وفي الحديث:
" مروهم بالصلاة وهم أبناء سبع

QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#3/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#3/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#3/r1.claim: Al-Qurṭubī refers readers to his earlier discussion of the Fire's fuel in Sūrat al-Baqara.
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#3/r1.anchor: { وقودها الناس والحجارة } تقدم في سورة «البقرة» القول فيه.

QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#3/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#3/r2.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#3/r2.claim: The angels guarding Hell are the zabāniya, harsh-hearted and merciless when pleaded with; they were created from anger and delight in punishment as humans delight in food and drink.
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#3/r2.anchor: يعني الملائكة الزبانية غلاظ القلوب لا يرحمون إذا استرحموا، خلقوا من الغضب

QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#3/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#3/r4.speaker: قيل
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#3/r4.claim: Another explanation takes ghilāẓ as harsh in speech and shidād as forceful in action.

QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#3/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#3/r5.speaker: قيل
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#3/r5.claim: Another explanation describes them as harsh in seizing the people of Hell and powerful against them.
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#3/r5.anchor: وقيل غلاظ في أخذهم أهل النار شداد عليهم

QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#3/r6.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#3/r6.speaker: قيل
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#3/r6.claim: Another view takes ghilāẓ as immense in body and shidād as strong; the word shadīd can describe someone powerful over a victim.
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#3/r6.anchor: وقيل: أراد بالغلاظ ضخامة أجسامهم، وبالشدة القوة.

QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#3/r7.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#3/r7.speaker: ابن عباس
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#3/r7.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says the distance between one angel's shoulders is a year's journey and one blow from his mace can drive seventy thousand people into Hell's depths.
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#3/r7.anchor: قال ابن عباس: ما بين منكبي الواحد منهم مسيرة سنة، وقوة الواحد منهم أن يضرب بالمقمع

QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#3/r8.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#3/r8.speaker: عبد الرحمن بن زيد عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#3/r8.claim: Ibn Wahb transmits from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Zayd a Prophetic report that the distance between a keeper's shoulders is like the distance between east and west.
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#3/r8.anchor:
وحدثنا عبد الرحمن بن زيد قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم في خزنة جهنم:
" ما بين منكبي أحدهم

QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#4/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#4/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#4/r1.claim: The angels do not disobey by adding anything to God's command or diminishing it.
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#4/r1.anchor: أي لا يخالفونه في أمره من زيادة أو نقصان

QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#4/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#4/r2.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#4/r2.claim: They perform what they are commanded at its proper time, neither delaying nor advancing it.
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#4/r2.anchor: أي في وقته، فلا يؤخرونه ولا يقدمونه.

QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#4/r3.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#4/r3.speaker: بعض المعتزلة
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#4/r3.claim: Some Muʿtazilites say obeying God's command is the angels' delight, as dwelling in Paradise delights its people.
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#4/r3.anchor: وقيل أي لذتهم في امتثال أمر الله كما أن سرور أهل الجنة في الكون في الجنة

QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#4/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#4/r4.speaker: بعض المعتزلة
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#4/r4.claim: The Muʿtazilites hold that imposing a duty tomorrow is impossible.
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#4/r4.anchor: ذكره بعض المعتزلة. وعندهم أنه يستحيل التكليف غدا.

QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#4/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#4/r5.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#4/r5.claim: Al-Qurṭubī rejects that doctrine: the people of truth affirm that God may impose duties today and tomorrow, and do not deny that angels can be charged with duties; God acts as He wills.
QURTUBI-FULL:66:6#4/r5.anchor: ولا يخفى معتقد أهل الحق في أن الله يكلف العبد اليوم وغدا، ولا ينكر التكليف في حق الملائكة.
